Representatives from various textile mills and the Environmental Protection Agency also discussed supply-chain traceability challenges, wastewater treatment costs, and the necessity of a clear government roadmap and financial support for decarbonization.

The summit concluded with practical capacity-building sessions. Industry representatives, professionals, and students received hands-on training in greenhouse gas accounting, industrial energy auditing, and decarbonization planning to help bridge technical and resource gaps.

stories.title: APTMA and German VFI Agree to Boost Bilateral Textile Trade
stories.summary:
The All Pakistan Textile Mills Association (APTMA) and the German Importers Association (VFI) have agreed to strengthen bilateral trade and improve sustainability reporting between Pakistan and Germany. The agreement was reached during a high-level delegation visit to APTMA, which included VFI Managing Director Dr. Michael Arretz alongside Fruit of Sustainability (FOS) CEO Sarim Mahmood and Deputy Managing Director Saman Aslam.

Dr. Arretz stated that Germany aims to consolidate its trade ties with medium-sized economies like Pakistan, praising the local textile industry's compliance efforts. Funded by the German government, VFI represents over 300 companies and prefers working with Pakistan amid changing dynamics in China. While general services are free, specialized reports carry a fee.

APTMA Chairman Asad Shafi highlighted the significance of the GSP+ facility, noting that 78 percent of Pakistani products enjoy duty-free access to the European Union. Since 2013, Pakistan's exports to the EU have risen by 73 percent, and exports to Germany have grown by 40 percent.

Shafi added that APTMA members comply with 27 GSP+ conventions alongside standards such as SA 8000 and Oeko-Tex. The domestic textile sector is actively transitioning away from fossil fuels toward preferred fibers while installing efficient effluent and water treatment facilities.

stories.title: Ben Shelton Reaches ATP Finals Semifinals After Tough Win Over Rafael Jodar
stories.summary:
American tennis player Ben Shelton secured his place in the ATP Finals semi-finals in Turin following a hard-fought victory over Spain's Rafael Jodar. Shelton overcame the 20-year-old newcomer 7-6 (10/8), 7-5 in a demanding encounter that featured a closely contested opening set tie-break. Jodar held two set points during the tie-break before Shelton managed to claim the set after more than an hour of play. Shelton then broke serve early in the second set, weathered a brief comeback by his opponent, and closed out the match to seal his progression.

Shelton's qualification was confirmed later in the day when Arthur Fils lost the first set of his match against world number one Alexander Zverev. Fils needed a straight-sets victory over Zverev to snatch the second qualifying spot from the John McEnroe Group, but Zverev took the opening set 6-4 and ultimately won the match 6-4, 7-6 (8/6). Zverev finished the group stage undefeated and will face the runner-up from the group comprising Daniil Medvedev and Frances Tiafoe in the next round.

Shelton joins Zverev and Carlos Alcaraz in the final four of the elite season-ending tournament. Jodar expressed immense pride in his breakthrough season despite finishing the week with three defeats in his debut appearance. Meanwhile, world number three Alcaraz awaited the results of an MRI scan concerning a hamstring injury sustained during his previous match against Medvedev.

The tournament continues to headline top-tier men's tennis as the remaining contenders vie for the prestigious title in Turin. Shelton's tenacity through crucial moments exemplifies the high standard required to compete at this level against the world's best players.

stories.title: Engro Fertilizers and Waseela Partner to Improve Farm Yields
stories.summary:
Engro Fertilizers and Waseela have launched a strategic partnership aimed at enhancing farmers' access to specialized crop nutrition solutions and reliable agricultural advisory services. The collaboration seeks to address critical needs within Pakistan's agricultural sector, enabling growers to make more informed nutrition decisions, improve crop yields, and boost overall farm profitability.

The initiative pairs Waseela's farmer-focused advisory platform with Engro Fertilizers' specialized crop nutrition portfolio. By combining practical agricultural guidance with high-quality fertilizer solutions, the partnership equips farmers with the essential nutrients required for healthy crop development and better agricultural outcomes.

Awais Mushtaq Paracha, Vice President of Marketing at Engro Fertilizers, highlighted that the company's success is tied to the prosperity of farmers. He noted that specialized products like Engro Zabardast Urea, which combines urea with Bioactive Zinc, and Engro Zarkhez, which supplies essential potash and other nutrients, are central to supporting robust crop growth.

Tania Aidrus, CEO of Waseela, emphasized that the platform was established to provide timely access to essential agricultural inputs and trusted advisory services, especially during peak growing seasons like rice cultivation. She noted that partnering with Engro Fertilizers brings specialized nutrition solutions closer to growers, helping them make timely, informed decisions.

stories.title: India Reaches 159-1 Against New Zealand Following Costly Fielding Errors
stories.summary:
India capitalized on multiple fielding miscues by New Zealand to close day two of the first Test in Wellington at 159-1, trailing the hosts by 209 runs. Openers Yashasvi Jaiswal and KL Rahul forged a commanding 130-run partnership in just 27.5 sessions. Jaiswal scored 85 runs off 89 balls but benefited from early reprieves, being dropped on zero and six by Henry Nicholls and Glenn Phillips. Rahul also received a life on five when New Zealand failed to review an lbw appeal, finishing the day unbeaten on 52 alongside Devdutt Padikkal on 16.

New Zealand's first innings had concluded earlier at 368 after lunch at the Basin Reserve, anchored by Nicholls' resilient, unbeaten 175. Nicholls shared a vital 216-run partnership with Phillips, who contributed 118 runs after New Zealand had slipped to 70-5 on the opening day. Jasprit Bumrah led the Indian bowling attack with 4-92 from 29 overs, while Akash Deep provided economical support with 3-53. However, India's bowlers struggled with consistency in length, allowing New Zealand's lower-middle order to stabilize their total.

During India's response, New Zealand seamers bowled poor lines that Jaiswal and Rahul punished aggressively after the tea break. Jaiswal was eventually dismissed by Matt Henry, caught behind by Tom Blundell, after hitting numerous boundaries. Henry ended as New Zealand's standout bowler with 1-43 from a disciplined spell.

The two-match Test series will conclude next week in Christchurch. Both teams look to address bowling consistency and fielding discipline as the contest heads into the crucial middle stages of the opening fixture.

stories.title: Punjab Safe Cities Authority Introduces Phone Shake SOS Feature
stories.summary:
The Punjab Safe Cities Authority has launched an advanced 'Phone Shake' facility integrated into the Women Safety App. This new digital feature allows women to trigger an SOS emergency alert merely by shaking their mobile phones, removing the necessity to place phone calls during perilous situations.

According to a spokesperson for the authority, the update is designed to make emergency police assistance more discreet, immediate, and accessible. It addresses scenarios where victims face direct threats, harassment, or severe emergencies that render speaking aloud or explaining circumstances impossible. Once an alert is initiated and confirmed, the Safe City Control Room receives instant notification to dispatch nearby police personnel.

Beyond the shake-activated SOS, the application includes a 'Connect to Safe City' function. This capability permits users to stream live video footage directly from their smartphone cameras to the control room, empowering authorities to evaluate threats more accurately and direct appropriate interventions.

The platform also supports live chat and video calling connections with law enforcement. Furthermore, it incorporates various auxiliary safety services such as ride-sharing integration, location reviews, and legal guidance, ultimately bolstering personal security and support for women during daily travel and routines.

stories.title: Pakistan Auto Financing Surges for 23rd Consecutive Month in October
stories.summary:
Outstanding car loans in Pakistan expanded for the twenty-third straight month, climbing to Rs416.5 billion in October from Rs407 billion in September, according to data released by the State Bank of Pakistan (SBP). Strong consumer demand for cars, sport utility vehicles, pickups, and vans propelled combined sales to 24,418 units in October. This figure represents a 41 percent increase year on year and a 62 percent increase month on month, bringing cumulative sales for the first four months of the 2027 fiscal year to 74,898 units, which is 26 percent higher than the previous year.

The central bank raised its policy interest rate to 12 percent on October 26, up from 11.5 percent, though a banker noted that the full impact of this adjustment will likely appear in November auto financing figures alongside new auto policy measures. Auto parts maker and exporter Mashood Ali Khan pointed out that while the SBP previously lowered the policy rate significantly from a peak of 22 percent to offer relief, the pace of economic recovery is moderating as KIBOR rates begin to edge upward. Khan also mentioned that some private banks are offering corporate clients financing for up to 70 percent of a vehicle's value with five-year repayment tenures.

Proposed updates under the new auto policy could reshape consumer demand by potentially increasing vehicle financing limits to Rs10 million for hybrid and electric vehicles while extending loan tenures to five years. Khan noted that the market is currently expanding due to the rising presence of Chinese automotive brands alongside growing interest in hybrid and electric models. However, he warned that if this vehicle financing expansion primarily boosts imported Completely Built Units or increases imports of semi-knocked-down and completely knocked-down kits without strong local manufacturing commitments, Pakistan could face a heavier foreign exchange burden.

The data underscores a dynamic period for Pakistan's automobile sector, balancing robust consumer enthusiasm against broader macroeconomic and policy considerations. As industry stakeholders await the finalization of new policy measures and observe the delayed effects of recent interest rate hikes, the sector's trajectory remains closely tied to regulatory frameworks governing imports, financing limits, and local industrial growth.

stories.title: Pakistan Stock Exchange Rebounds With Mild Recovery Amid Value Buying
stories.summary:
The Pakistan Stock Exchange (PSX) broke a two-session losing streak on Thursday, with the benchmark KSE-100 index finishing in positive territory as attractive valuations prompted selective buying. According to Topline Securities Ltd, the index rebounded from a sharp decline in the previous session, gaining 477.86 points, or 0.27 percent, to close at 176,772.19. Heavyweight stocks provided crucial support to the market, though persistent geopolitical and domestic political uncertainties kept overall investor sentiment cautious and capped potential upside gains.

Major positive contributors to the index included Engro Holdings, Engro Fertiliser, Fauji Fertiliser, Mari Energies, and Systems Ltd, which collectively added around 603 points. Conversely, profit-taking weighed down United Bank, Pakistan Services, Adamjee Insurance, Attock Refinery, and Habib Bank, erasing a cumulative 181 points. Ali Najib, Deputy Head of Trading at Arif Habib Ltd, observed that while the market opened strongly and maintained positive momentum throughout the day, profit-taking during the latter half pared initial gains amid ongoing volatility linked to domestic politics and Middle East tensions.

Value buying emerged at lower levels after the index dropped to a weekly low of 176,054 on Wednesday, offering a floor for the market's recovery. On the macroeconomic front, large-scale manufacturing output demonstrated gradual improvement, registering a 2.4 percent year-on-year and 3.2 percent month-on-month increase in September, pushing big industry production up by 2.1 percent in the first quarter of the 2027 fiscal year. Despite the positive index movement, overall market activity remained subdued, with trading volume falling 2.33 percent to 724.77 million shares and total traded value declining 18.56 percent to Rs21.1 billion, led heavily by WorldCall Telecom.

Analysts anticipate that the market will maintain a cautious recovery path driven by lower-level value buying and improving industrial metrics, though volatility is expected to persist due to underlying political and geopolitical factors. The delicate balance between encouraging macroeconomic indicators and prevailing uncertainties continues to dictate short-term trading strategies across the exchange.

stories.title: Elon Musk Regrets Heavy Midterm Spending After Republican Defeats
stories.summary:
Tesla and SpaceX CEO Elon Musk stated on Wednesday that he felt 'pretty foolish' regarding the substantial funds he deployed during the United States midterm elections, following sweeping losses for Republican candidates. The world's richest man invested nearly half a billion dollars to support Republican nominees and to preserve conservative control in Texas, a state that hosts Tesla, SpaceX, and a planned joint chipmaking venture. These electoral investments faltered as Democrats captured both chambers of Congress and Democrat Gina Hinojosa defeated Republican Greg Abbott in the Texas gubernatorial race.

Speaking virtually at the New York Times DealBook Summit, Musk described the outcome as a stinging rebuke to U.S. President Donald Trump, a close ally whom Musk had previously helped elect. Reflecting on the results, Musk admitted that if he could rewind the clock, he would have spent considerably less money, noting that campaign cash alone cannot dictate an election outcome. While he acknowledged that Republican candidates might have performed even worse without his financial backing, he expressed dissatisfaction with the lack of tangible political return for his massive investment.

Shifting to his commercial artificial intelligence ventures, Musk discussed the operational relationship between SpaceX and Anthropic. He stated that Anthropic was 'extremely likely' to continue renting computing capacity from SpaceX and was seeking significantly more resources. According to Musk, the highest-probability outcome involves Anthropic requesting an additional 10 gigawatts of computing capacity from SpaceX to support its expanding AI infrastructure demands.

The billionaire's remarks highlight a sobering moment for high-stakes political donor involvement, contrasting the limits of campaign spending with the expansive growth trajectories of his private tech enterprises. As Musk evaluates his political footprint post-midterms, his primary corporate ventures continue to navigate major infrastructural expansions and high-demand commercial agreements.

stories.title: Israeli Politicians Condemn Incitement Following Suspected Mosque Arson Attack
stories.summary:
Israeli police launched an investigation into a suspected arson attack on a mosque in the northern Arab village of Dahi on Thursday, drawing sharp condemnation from prominent politicians who blamed the incident on inflammatory rhetoric from caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s camp. The mosque fire occurred amidst a backdrop of heightened political tension following unprecedented electoral gains by Arab citizens in elections the previous month, which prompted repeated hostile rhetoric from Netanyahu and right-wing allies targeting the Arab minority.

According to police, a room in the lower section of the mosque was targeted in the suspected arson, and graffiti was sprayed on a nearby street. Khaled al Zoubi, the mosque's imam, reported discovering smoke and fire upon arriving for morning prayers, noting that security footage captured three masked individuals failing to enter through the door before breaking a second-floor window and tossing incendiary bottles inside. Although the damage was limited, Zoubi characterized the event as a racist hate crime, while nearby walls featured scrawled graffiti reading 'revenge'.

Opposition leaders sharply criticized the incident, linking it directly to government rhetoric. Yair Lapid of the anti-Netanyahu bloc called the mosque burning a heinous hate crime and urged an immediate halt to rampant incitement against Arab Israelis. Yair Golan, leader of the Democrats party, labeled the event 'Jewish terrorism' stemming directly from government campaigns. Youssef Jabareen, head of the Arab-majority Joint List, visited Dahi and explicitly held Netanyahu, his cabinet, and associated extremists responsible for translating dangerous rhetoric into real-world violence against the Arab population.

Arab Israelis, who are descendants of Palestinians remaining after Israel's creation in 1948, make up approximately 20 percent of the nation's current population. The incident underscores deep-seated societal tensions, exacerbated by repeated, unsubstantiated allegations of electoral fraud leveled by Netanyahu against Arab-majority parties, claims that election authorities have consistently rejected.

stories.title: Scientists Successfully Grow Edible Potatoes in Simulated Lunar Soil
stories.summary:
Potatoes, known for providing substantial calories, vitamins, minerals, and fiber, could soon become a viable food source on the moon. Researchers at Oregon State University in Corvallis, Oregon, have successfully grown safe-to-eat, nutritious potatoes using simulated lunar soil mixed with organic material.

Led by plant biologist Aymeric Goyer and supported by NASA, the study utilized an early-maturing potato variety called Modoc, which features red skin and white flesh. Investigators discovered that when the lunar simulant was sufficiently supplemented with organic matter, the potatoes performed just as well as those grown in Earth soil.

The research matters because space agencies, including those in the United States and China, plan to send astronauts to the lunar surface in the coming years and establish long-term bases. Transporting all necessary food from Earth is highly impractical, making a local food source vital for sustaining personnel.

According to Goyer, potatoes are an ideal choice for lunar agriculture because they deliver more calories per land area than many alternative crops. They are rich in potassium, vitamin C, and protein, and possess a high satiety index.

The findings were published on Thursday in the journal Microgravity.

stories.title: Government and Jamaat-i-Islami Finalize Relief Package Draft Proposals
stories.summary:
Representatives from the federal government and Jamaat-i-Islami (JI) have concluded technical committee negotiations regarding public relief measures. Liaqat Baloch, the head of the JI negotiating committee, announced that both parties have finalized draft proposals following more than two months of discussions driven by the party's demands to abolish the petroleum levy and address rising fuel prices.

The breakthrough follows an early September agreement to establish committees to examine levy reductions. During the tenth round of talks on November 10, the sides agreed on broad outlines. A final relief package is scheduled to be formally announced following a meeting between Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif and JI Emir Hafiz Naeemur Rehman on November 24 or 25.

During negotiations, the government cited constraints linked to its International Monetary Fund (IMF) commitments, but formulated a plan to gradually reduce the petroleum levy before the next budget. The petroleum levy is a critical federal revenue source, with budgeted receipts of approximately Rs1.677 trillion for the current fiscal year. Baloch asserted that the campaign secured substantial relief, including temporary refinery contributions totaling Rs15 billion over 30 days.

Under the proposed measures, the prime minister's fuel-relief program will expand to cover owners of vehicles with engine capacities up to 1,000cc, alongside small farmers owning up to 12.5 acres who use fuel for tractors. Additionally, the government accepted JI's positions regarding windfall profits for oil companies and addressed liquefied natural gas stay orders, while JI plans to hold a public gathering in Quetta on November 22.

stories.title: Government Implements Strict Import Controls on Camera-Enabled Smart Glasses
stories.summary:
The federal government has introduced new regulatory hurdles for the importation of camera-enabled smart glasses by tying shipments to strict approval processes. Under the updated regulations, bringing these devices into the country requires type approval and a Certificate of Conformity from the Pakistan Telecommunication Authority, alongside a specialized clearance certificate.

The Ministry of Commerce issued SRO 2137(I)/2026 on November 18, 2026, officially amending the Import Policy Order of 2022. The amendment inserts a new entry, Serial No. 39, into Part-II of Appendix-B, specifically targeting camera-enabled smart glasses under Pakistan Customs Tariff codes 8517.62, 8525.89, and 9004.90.

In addition to PTA requirements, the amendment mandates that importers obtain a No Objection Certificate from the Interior and Narcotics Control Division before a Certificate of Conformity can be issued. This adds an extra layer of screening for commercial clearance and regulatory compliance.

The regulatory changes were enacted under Section 3(1) of the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, 1950. Furthermore, the Ministry of Commerce clarified that these newly added provisions will not supersede or restrict existing rules associated with the same tariff headings elsewhere in the Import Policy Order.

stories.title: Punjab Chief Minister Approves Second Phase of Solar Panel Initiative
stories.summary:
Punjab Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz Sharif has given her approval for the second phase of the CM Solar Panel Scheme, expanding the target number of recipients from 90,000 to 100,000 households. The decision was announced during a high-level meeting in Lahore focused on bioenergy and biofuel projects utilizing animal, agricultural, and solid waste.

During the briefing, Provincial Minister Faisal Khokhar and the energy secretary reported that the initial phase attracted over 350,000 applications. Out of those, 89,869 families successfully received solar systems, which helped cut their electricity bills by one-third. Additionally, 76 schools across the province have transitioned to solar power through a pilot initiative.

As part of the broader energy strategy, the chief minister ordered comprehensive energy audits for all major hospitals to ensure proper electrical panel installation based on specific power requirements. She also authorized a pilot scheme to deploy 5,000 solar panels in Cholistan and shift 40 regional water supply systems to solar energy. Furthermore, in-principle approval was granted for a pilot project aimed at generating power from 3,000 tonnes of municipal waste.

Discussions during the session also covered a proposed biorefinery in Nankana Sahib designed to process rice straw and agricultural leftovers, alongside the expansion of private dairy and community biogas facilities. Officials noted that Punjab possesses the capacity to yield 7.15 billion cubic metres of biogas yearly from 490,000 tonnes of animal waste, alongside an extra 1.6 billion units of electricity from various biological refuse sources.

stories.title: Punjab Assembly Speaker Urges Political Dialogue on Creating New Provinces
stories.summary:
Punjab Assembly Speaker Malik Muhammad Ahmad Khan has emphasized the need for political parties to engage in discussions regarding the establishment of new provinces. Speaking to journalists in Lahore on Thursday, he asserted that decisions of this magnitude must be handled by political leaders through proper constitutional channels rather than direct public referendums, warning that asking citizens directly could create unpredictable complications.

Highlighting constitutional principles, the speaker noted that Article 181 outlines the necessary legal framework. He questioned the consistency of political stances on provincial divisions, noting that parties must address resource distribution grievances, rising populations, and declining living standards. He expressed optimism that prominent political figures like PPP Chairman Bilawal Bhutto Zardari and Punjab Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz would help guide the nation forward.

Turning to separate national matters, the speaker described the events of May 9 involving the PTI founder and supporters as serious offenses against the military and state institutions. He also addressed concerns raised by JUI-F chief Maulana Fazlur Rehman regarding tribal regions, advocating for dialogue to resolve the issues. Regarding his own party, the PML-N, he stated that the government must carefully evaluate its official stance on new provinces.

In a separate meeting, the speaker hosted a delegation from the Pakistan Film Producers Association, featuring Chairman Mian Amjad Farzand, actor Shaan Shahid, and filmmaker Syed Noor. Both sides discussed legislative support, financial assistance, and the establishment of a film city to help revive the nation's cinema industry.

stories.title: Lahore High Court Upholds January 1 Age Limit for PMS Exams
stories.summary:
The Lahore High Court has officially dismissed a petition challenging the maximum age limit set for the Provincial Management Service (PMS) examinations for the year 2027. The court upheld the decision to fix January 1, 2027, as the cut-off date for applicants seeking to appear in the competitive tests.

The legal challenge was brought forward by petitioner Jehangir Sher, who requested the court to direct the relevant government department to revise the age restriction date. During the proceedings, the bench asked the petitioner's legal counsel to present any statutory law or legal provision that justified extending the age limit for the examination.

Failing to provide any supporting legal documentation or provisions, the counsel could not substantiate the request. Concurrently, a government law officer defended the schedule, stating that the department held full legal authority to determine the date parameters for the PMS exams.

Following arguments from both legal teams, the Lahore High Court dismissed the petition in limine, thereby affirming the department's timeline for the upcoming 2027 provincial examinations.

stories.title: Lahore Named ECO Tourism Capital for 2027 at Azerbaijan Ceremony
stories.summary:
Lahore has been officially designated as the ECO Tourism Capital for the year 2027, a title that will see the city host numerous cultural and tourism events bringing together international delegates, artists, and member state representatives. Punjab Tourism Secretary Socrat Aman formally accepted the prestigious title during a special ceremony held in Shusha, Azerbaijan.

At the event, a dedicated Pakistani pavilion highlighted the nation's natural landscapes, historical monuments, traditional hospitality, and cultural heritage, positioning Punjab as a primary entry point for travelers. The upcoming 2027 calendar will feature the Lahore Biennale, culinary celebrations showcasing the city's famous food culture, traditional arts, music festivals, and exhibitions highlighting Mughal, Sikh, and diverse historical eras.

Key provincial landmarks such as Lahore Fort, the Walled City, museums, and various spiritual and archaeological sites will serve as main attractions for international visitors. The initiative aims to foster regional cooperation, boost tourism investments, and strengthen global partnerships within the Economic Cooperation Organization region.

Punjab Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz Sharif remarked that the city is fully prepared to welcome global travelers and showcase the region's centuries-old heritage. Meanwhile, Punjab Senior Minister Marriyum Aurangzeb credited the achievement to the government's broader Magnificent Punjab vision, which prioritizes the restoration of historical urban centers and the enhancement of tourism infrastructure.

stories.title: Field Marshal Asim Munir Reaffirms Military Support for Balochistan Peace
stories.summary:
Field Marshal Syed Asim Munir visited Turbat to attend a memorial ceremony for martyrs, where he laid a floral wreath and offered Fateha at the Martyrs’ Monument. The visit was aimed at reviewing security, operational preparedness, and socio-economic development initiatives in Balochistan.

During his trip, the Field Marshal received briefings from officials regarding the regional security environment, actions against externally sponsored terrorism, and progress on public welfare projects. He praised the troops stationed in the area for their high morale, professional competence, and dedication under difficult conditions.

The Inter-Services Public Relations (ISPR) highlighted that the visit underscored the military's dedication to maintaining territorial integrity and countering security threats. Field Marshal Munir explicitly stated that the armed forces would continue supporting sustainable development and lasting peace in the province.

This engagement demonstrates the ongoing focus of the Pakistan Army on combining security operations with socio-economic advancement. By standing shoulder to shoulder with locals, the military seeks to foster stability and improve the living standards of the residents of Balochistan.

stories.title: Shehbaz and Zardari Agree to Resolve Administrative and Political Disputes
stories.summary:
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif and President Asif Ali Zardari met at Aiwan-e-Sadr alongside Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi to discuss the national political landscape and regional developments. Both leaders agreed that current political disputes must be resolved through mutual consultations, dialogue, and consensus.

The high-level meeting addressed emerging tensions within the ruling coalition regarding proposals for new administrative units and provincial restructuring. While Interior Minister Naqvi and Information Minister Attaullah Tarar previously suggested public consultations and referendums on administrative reforms, PPP Chairman Bilawal Bhutto Zardari strongly opposed any division of Sindh without local consent, warning of potential social unrest.

Despite differing stances on restructuring Sindh, the leadership emphasized that relevant stakeholders should engage directly to find acceptable solutions. They also reviewed past constitutional amendments, noting that previous changes had been successfully introduced through cooperation among coalition partners.

This dialogue carries significant weight as the coalition attempts to navigate conflicting views on provincial boundaries. Reaffirming their commitment to cooperation, the Prime Minister and President aim to prevent further polarization through structured negotiations.

stories.title: NationalGrid Plans Rs100 Billion Sukuk Programme Without Government Backing
stories.summary:
The National-Grid Company of Pakistan Limited has initiated steps to raise up to Rs 100 billion through a Shariah-compliant Sukuk programme. The funds will be utilized to expand and modernize the national electricity transmission network, improve grid reliability, and satisfy growing energy demand.

To execute the plan, NationalGrid has issued a Request for Proposals to select lead managers for structuring the issuance. The programme features an inaugural tranche of up to Rs 20 billion, with subsequent phases depending on market conditions and project needs over a repayment period of up to 10 years.

A notable aspect of the financial strategy is that NationalGrid intends to secure the funding using its own financial strength rather than depending on a Government of Pakistan guarantee. This move marks a shift toward greater financial independence and market-based infrastructure financing.

Managing Director Engr. Altaf Hussain Malik emphasized that upgrading the transmission network requires substantial investment and sustainable long-term capital. Meanwhile, Chief Financial Officer Muhammad Aamir Khan noted that the initiative diversifies funding sources by tapping into domestic capital markets alongside international development partners.

stories.title: PSO Board Reviews Business Process Re-engineering and Automation Initiatives
stories.summary:
Pakistan State Oil (PSO) is planning a comprehensive review of its proposed Business Process Re-engineering exercise following observations by its Chief Executive Officer. During a Board Procurement Committee meeting, the CEO noted that the restructuring plan had been developed largely independent of other workstreams and lacked a trial phase, except in the Supply Department.

Management requested a six-week period to reassess the BPR exercise, align human resources, define processes, and ensure proper integration with ongoing automation projects. The review will also encompass a post-investment assessment of the Faisalabad terminal and supply chain digitalisation efforts.

During the meeting, the Committee examined updates on the deployment of Automated Tank Gauge probes at retail outlets. Initial installations have prioritized Karachi due to pilferage concerns, with a broader rollout targeting 1,349 sites by December 2026 and another 1,051 sites by June 2027, potentially extending to October 2027.

Additionally, the Committee reviewed delays regarding the track-and-trace system for small-pack lubricants, noting that testing on Filling Line No. 1 concluded in July 2026. Management also reported that the Faisalabad terminal is operational, though further data is needed over the next few months to complete its post-investment review.

stories.title: Federal Tax Ombudsman Uncovers Multimillion-Rupee Sales Tax Frauds
stories.summary:
In Islamabad, Federal Tax Ombudsman Zafar Hijazi issued a landmark order exposing systemic loopholes in corporate incorporation, sales tax registration, and digital tax administration. The investigation uncovered fraudulent sales transactions involving hundreds of millions of rupees after cybercriminals used virtual private network (VPN) connections to gain unauthorized access to a taxpayer's IRIS account via Indonesian and Emirati IP endpoints. Fake supplies were injected into sales tax returns to facilitate fraudulent input tax adjustments, consuming accumulated carry-forward input tax and exposing an innocent taxpayer to severe tax liabilities.

A newly incorporated private limited company emerged as a major second-tier beneficiary in this fraudulent network. The firm obtained both its Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan (SECP) incorporation and sales tax registration on consecutive days despite uploading identical profile documents instead of mandatory items like paid utility bills and proof of premises ownership. The automated registration system processed these files without meaningful verification, while alterations to the company's directorship were updated in Federal Board of Revenue (FBR) records before SECP approval. Bank statements confirmed the complainant received no payments, and state departments verified no such procurement records existed.

To combat these vulnerabilities, the FTO issued comprehensive institutional and technological directives. The FBR was ordered to initiate legal actions for blacklisting and recovery against invoice beneficiaries, launch criminal probes into actual cybercriminals, and investigate the newly registered company's credentials. Furthermore, authorities must review Rule 5 of the Sales Tax Rules, 2006, establish a 30-day timeframe for post-registration scrutiny, and modify Form 181 procedures to prevent unauthorized director changes. Pakistan Revenue Automation Limited (PRAL) was instructed to deploy multi-factor authentication, biometric verification, and automated IP monitoring within the IRIS Portal.

The FTO emphasized that while facilitating legitimate businesses through automation is crucial, it must be balanced with strict verification, risk assessment, and post-registration oversight. The Commissioner Inland Revenue was directed to consider reversing the fraudulent consumption of the complainant's carry-forward input tax, and all concerned entities were given 60 days to report compliance, ensuring that the ease of doing business does not facilitate tax fraud.

stories.title: Faysal Bank Wins Two Honors at Islamic Retail Banking Awards
stories.summary:
Faysal Bank Limited secured two notable accolades at the 12th Islamic Retail Banking Awards 2026 held in Karachi. The institution was honored as the Best Mid-Sized Islamic Retail Bank in Pakistan for 2026.

In addition to the primary category win, Faysal Bank Limited received the IRBA Excellence Award for Islamic Banking Growth in Pakistan 2026. These honors recognize the bank's market performance during the period.

Yousaf Hussain, the President and Chief Executive Officer of Faysal Bank Limited, commented on the double win in a press release. He stated that these recognitions reflect the collective commitment of the bank toward advancing Islamic banking practices in Pakistan.

stories.title: Competition Commission of Pakistan Handles 32 Ongoing Sector Enquiries
stories.summary:
In Islamabad, the Competition Commission of Pakistan (CCP) reported that it is conducting 32 ongoing enquiries into suspected anti-competitive practices across 14 different sectors, alongside 29 completed enquiries. According to officials, 19 ongoing and 22 completed investigations target deceptive marketing practices under Section 10 of the Competition Act, 2010. Sector-wise, ongoing deceptive marketing probes include seven in fast-moving consumer goods, five in construction, two each in automobiles and beauty cosmetics, and one each in pharmaceuticals, home appliances, and services or hospitality. Out of 22 finished enquiries in this category, nine were in fast-moving consumer goods, three each in education and real estate, two each in automobiles, financial services, and home appliances, and one in services or hospitality.

The remaining 13 ongoing and seven completed enquiries focus on prohibited agreements under Section 4 and abuse of dominance under Section 3 of the Act. Ongoing investigations involve electrical and home appliances, paints, telecommunications and internet services, aluminum utensils, automobiles, ceramics, foreign exchange services, LPG transportation, and road maintenance. Completed investigations cover power-sector procurement, edible oils and ghee, municipal administration, outdoor advertising, and telecommunications and internet services. Officials emphasized that restricting market rivalry in industrial inputs and services raises construction expenses, business overheads, and supply-chain prices for consumers.

Between January 1, 2025, and November 19, 2026, the CCP Market Intelligence Unit recorded 177 detections, comprising 74 fair-trade matters, 36 cartels and trade abuses, and 67 mergers and acquisitions. From fiscal years 2023-24 to 2025-26, the commission received 226 merger applications and issued 201 orders, including three Phase-II rulings. Consumer and lifestyle businesses led the 198 Phase-I approvals with 37, followed by industrials and materials with 32, financial services and insurance with 31, and energy with 26.

Foreign investments linked to these approved mergers totaled Rs71.92 billion over the three-year period. Capital and investors originated from eight primary jurisdictions, namely the United Arab Emirates, Singapore, the Netherlands, Saudi Arabia, Italy, Hong Kong, Canada, and the United States. CCP officials noted that merger reviews safeguard competitive markets while balancing corporate restructuring and international capital inflows.

stories.title: Villagers Fear Forced Excavation Over Demanded Canal Bridge
stories.summary:
Residents of Gharibwal village in Pind Dadan Khan tehsil are facing alleged threats of police action and forced excavation by authorities. The dispute centers on an unexcavated section of the Asian Development Bank-financed Jalalpur Canal passing through the village. Villagers have refused to permit construction work until a bridge is built to maintain their access to homes, agricultural fields, and grazing lands. A representative assembly of local villages, Daman LokPerhoo, stated that the Irrigation Department, police, and local administration warned residents on November 18 to halt their protests or face coercive legal measures. Excavating the final section without a bridge would isolate the community and force local children to travel an extra 10 kilometers each way to attend school.

The assembly gathered in Gharibwal on November 15 to express solidarity and formally requested intervention from the Asian Development Bank and the project director. The unexcavated stretch serves as the final direct connection between the village and northern residential and grazing areas, which have already been disrupted by the canal's route. Previous peaceful resistance by villagers halted excavation attempts, and the community questioned why they face intimidation for raising concerns while the Asian Development Bank encourages grievance mechanisms. Daman LokPerhoo demanded an immediate halt to police operations and forced excavation, alongside a written timeline for the proposed bridge's construction.

Additionally, the assembly raised concerns regarding land compensation irregularities, stating that the land acquired for the 117-kilometer canal was compensated at roughly Rs1,100 per marla, or Rs176,000 per acre, which is significantly below replacement value. The organization alleged that some landowners have not received compensation and that revenue officials demanded illegal payments before releasing funds. It urged the Asian Development Bank to commission an independent audit of compensation disbursements and bribery allegations to ensure compliance with resettlement safeguards, alongside public disclosure of all distributed amounts.

The organization also warned of environmental risks, noting that the canal embankments have disrupted natural drainage systems from the Salt Range and increased flood dangers for nearby agriculture. Cross-drainage structures, such as one at Kaura near Gharibwal built less than two years ago, are reportedly clogged with silt, which could cause embankment breaches and soil salinity. Daman LokPerhoo urged the Asian Development Bank to clarify its stance before further site activities occur, noting that residents remain willing to participate in a formal, intimidation-free resolution process.

stories.title: Pakistan and Turkiye to Sign Judicial Cooperation MoU in Islamabad
stories.summary:
Pakistan's Supreme Court is set to welcome a high-level delegation from the Court of Cassation of the Republic of Türkiye for a multi-day visit between November 23 and 27, 2026. Headed by President Omer Kerkez, the visiting group includes judges and senior officials who will engage in official institutional meetings addressing contemporary challenges in adjudication, judicial administration, and reform initiatives.

A central focus of the delegation's schedule is the signing of a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) regarding judicial cooperation. Scheduled for November 23 at the Supreme Court, this agreement aims to establish a formal framework for institutional collaboration, capacity building, and the sharing of best practices. Furthermore, the partnership prioritizes the professional growth of district-level judiciaries through joint training programs, academic exchanges, and comparative legal practices, alongside integrating modern technologies to bolster efficiency, transparency, and access to justice.

The signing ceremony will be broadcast live from the Supreme Court. It is slated to be witnessed by prominent figures including judges from the Supreme Court and the Federal Constitutional Court, high court chief justices, the federal minister for law and justice, the attorney general, and various legal fraternity representatives.

Beyond their official duties, the Turkish delegation will tour culturally significant locations such as Taxila, the Walled City of Lahore, and the Faisal Mosque. This outreach underscores Pakistan's cultural heritage and highlights the importance of fostering enduring people-to-people ties between the two nations.

stories.title: Election Commission of Pakistan Summons Information Minister Atta Tarar
stories.summary:
The Election Commission of Pakistan (ECP) has summoned Information Minister Atta Tarar to address a petition he filed himself regarding a schedule change. A three-member bench led by Chief Election Commissioner Sikandar Sultan Raja is handling the matter, which concerns an alleged violation of the electoral code of conduct tied to an 8 November by-election in the NA-77 Gujranwala constituency.

The upcoming hearing is set for December 1. During a prior session, the electoral authority resummoned seven respondents alongside Tarar, including Sardar Ghias Gul, the former chief of Gujranwala Police who has since been transferred to Rawalpindi. Other resummoned individuals feature lawmaker-elect Raashid Bashir Virk, Gujranwala Deputy Commissioner Naveed Ahmad, District Monitoring Officer Syed Basit Ali, Returning Officer Sumaira Ambreen, Punjab Parliamentary Secretary Health Asma Naz Abbasi, and Punjab Assembly committee chairperson Qudsia Batool.

Controversy arose prior to the NA-77 poll when the ECP flagged media reports indicating that the information minister had arrived in the constituency via helicopter and participated in a public gathering. The election body's code of conduct strictly prohibits government functionaries from visiting active electoral constituencies once a polling schedule is notified, prompting the ECP to summon Tarar personally and warn that the election results could potentially be withheld.

Tensions escalated when Tarar failed to attend a previous hearing, drawing sharp warnings from the Chief Election Commissioner regarding the consequences of ignoring official directives. Meanwhile, the ECP officially notified Pakistan Muslim League Nawaz candidate Raashid Bashir Virk as the winner of the NA-77 seat, which had become vacant following the September 11 passing of his father, Mahmood Bashir Virk.

stories.title: Ten Fatally Injured in Bus and Gas Tanker Collision in Gwadar
stories.summary:
A collision between a passenger bus and a gas tanker along the Makran Coastal Highway near Gwadar resulted in ten fatalities and twenty-seven injuries. The impact of the crash sparked an intense fire that quickly engulfed both vehicles, trapping occupants and causing severe concern among witnesses who reported hearing the screams of women and children inside the bus.

Emergency response teams, including police, the Ormara Municipal Committee fire brigade, and various rescue units, rushed to the scene. Firefighters managed to bring the raging flames under control while rescue personnel worked to evacuate all individuals from the wreckage. Authorities confirmed that eight of the deceased were recovered from the passenger bus, while two bodies were retrieved from the gas tanker. Ormara Deputy Superintendent of Police Nabi Bakhsh Ronjha stated that all the victims lost their lives due to burn injuries.

The passenger bus was traveling from Turbat to Karachi when the crash occurred on the coastal highway. Following the initial emergency response, SP Aslam Bangulzai noted that teams were rapidly dispatched to handle the crisis. All twenty-seven injured individuals were rescued and transported to nearby hospitals for urgent medical treatment.

The devastating accident caused major disruptions along the Makran Coastal Highway. Traffic came to a standstill, leaving long lines of vehicles stranded in both directions while emergency crews cleared the site and managed the aftermath of the disaster.

stories.title: Port Qasim Receives Six Vessels Transporting Liquefied Petroleum Gas
stories.summary:
Six cargo vessels carrying a cumulative total of 55,417 metric tonnes of Liquefied Petroleum Gas arrived at Port Qasim over a six-day period from November 12 to November 18, according to data released by the Port Qasim Authority.

The largest shipments arrived during the latter half of the tracked timeframe. The vessel Seashine docked late Wednesday at 8:30 pm with 21,866 metric tonnes, while Pacific Star 1 arrived the previous day at 9:00 pm carrying 20,115 metric tonnes. Combined, these two large carriers made up approximately 76 percent of the total LPG volume imported during the week.

Earlier arrivals at the port included the Gas RGA, which docked on November 12 at 9:45 pm with 1,621 metric tonnes. Victoria Kosan arrived two days later at 10:48 pm carrying 4,387 metric tonnes.

The final two ships of the period arrived on November 17. Leonara Kosan docked at 1:54 am with 3,877 metric tonnes, and Alisa 1 berthed later that morning at 10:42 am with 3,551 metric tonnes of the fuel.

stories.title: کراچی کے علاقے لانڈھی میں گھریلو تنازع پر فائرنگ سے تین افراد ہلاک
stories.summary:
کراچی کے علاقے لانڈھی اولڈ مظفر آباد کے قریب ایک گھر میں پیش آنے والے فائرنگ کے واقعے میں خاتون سمیت تین افراد جاں بحق ہو گئے۔ ایدھی ترجمان کے مطابق جاں بحق ہونے والوں میں میاں بیوی اور خاتون کا بھائی شامل ہیں۔

پولیس اور قائد آباد پولیس کے مطابق ملزم ناصر احمد نے شاہ لطیف ٹاؤن سے آکر مظفر آباد کالونی میں اپنے سسرال کے اندر فائرنگ کی۔ فائرنگ کے نتیجے میں اس کی بیوی اسماء اور سالے محمد احسن موقع پر جاں بحق ہو گئے۔ اس کے بعد ملزم نے خود کو بھی گولی مار کر خودکشی کر لی، اور موقع سے ایک پستول برآمد کیا گیا۔

واقعے کی اطلاع ملتے ہی پولیس اور کرائم سین یونٹ فوری طور پر موقع پر پہنچ گئے۔ پولیس حکام نے تینوں لاشوں کو جناح اسپتال منتقل کر دیا ہے اور واقعے کی مزید تفتیش کا آغاز کر دیا گیا ہے۔

پولیس کے مطابق میاں بیوی کی شادی پندره سال قبل ہوئی تھی تاہم گزشتہ کچھ دنوں سے ان کے درمیان علیحدگی چل رہی تھی۔ جاں بحق ہونے والی خاتون اسماء نے خلع کے لیے عدالت سے رجوع کر رکھا تھا اور وہ ان دنوں اپنے والدین کے گھر مقیم تھیں۔

stories.title: پاکستان نے ریاض میں کنگ عبداللہ فنانشل ڈسٹرکٹ پر حوثی حملے کی مذمت کی
stories.summary:
پاکستان نے دارالحکومت ریاض میں واقع کنگ عبداللہ فنانشل ڈسٹرکٹ کے ایک ٹاور پر حوثی ملیشیا کی جانب سے کیے جانے والے حملے کی شدید الفاظ میں مذمت کی ہے۔ ترجمان دفتر خارجہ کے مطابق یہ جارحانہ کارروائی سعودی عرب کی خودمختاری کی سنگین خلاف ورزی ہے۔

دفتر خارجہ کے ترجمان نے اپنے بیان میں کہا ہے کہ حکومت اور عوام کی جانب سے سعودی عرب کے ساتھ مکمل یکجہتی کا اظہار کیا جاتا ہے۔ شہری بنیادی ڈھانچے اور اقتصادی تنصیبات کو مسلسل نشانہ بنانے کے سنگین نتائج برآمد ہوتے ہیں۔

ترجمان نے اس عزم کا اعادہ کیا کہ ایسے حملے بے گناہ افراد کی زندگیوں کو خطرے میں ڈالتے ہیں اور اس سے علاقائی امن و سلامتی کو بھی شدید خطرات لاحق ہوتے ہیں، اس لیے اس قسم کے قابل مذمت حملوں کا فوری خاتمہ ہونا ضروری ہے۔

بیان میں مزید کہا گیا ہے کہ پاکستان سعودی عرب کے اپنی خودمختاری، سالمیت کے دفاع اور اپنے شہریوں و مقیم افراد کے تحفظ کے جائز حق کی مکمل حمایت کرتا ہے۔ پاکستان خطے میں پائیدار امن اور استحکام کے قیام کی کوششیں جاری رکھے گا۔

stories.title: سہولیات کے فقدان پر عوامی تنقید، ملک بھر میں نئے صوبوں کا مطالبہ
stories.summary:
پاکستان بھر کے شہریوں نے ناقص کارکردگی اور بنیادی سہولیات کی عدم فراہمی پر شدید تنقید کرتے ہوئے ملک میں نئے انتظامی یونٹس کے قیام کا پرزور مطالبہ کیا ہے۔ کراچی، کوئٹہ، مانسہرہ اور ایبٹ آباد سمیت مختلف علاقوں کے شہریوں نے اس اقدام کی حمایت کی ہے۔

شہریوں کا کہنا ہے کہ ملک میں مہنگائی، بے روزگاری اور بدانتظامی عروج پر ہے اور آج بھی بنیادی سہولیات کا شدید فقدان پایا جاتا ہے۔ بڑھتی ہوئی آبادی اور بڑھتے ہوئے مسائل کے باعث اب موجودہ صوبوں سے نظام چلانا مشکل ہو چکا ہے، اس لیے ملک کو چھوٹے انتظامی یونٹس میں تقسیم کرنا ناگزیر ہو گیا ہے۔

عوام کا یہ بھی ماننا ہے کہ نئے صوبے بننے سے دور افتادہ علاقوں پر یکساں توجہ دی جا سکے گی اور ترقی کی راہیں کھلیں گی۔ اس سے مقامی وسائل مقامی افراد تک پہنچیں گے اور نوجوانوں کے لیے روزگار کے نئے مواقع بھی پیدا ہوں گے۔

شہریوں کے مطابق چھوٹے صوبوں کے قیام سے تعلیم، روزگار اور صحت جیسی بنیادی سہولیات ملک کے ہر شہر اور ہر فرد تک آسانی سے پہنچائی جا سکیں گی، جس سے بدانتظامی کے خاتمے میں بھی مدد ملے گی۔

stories.title: راولپنڈی ٹیسٹ: سری لنکا کا دوسری اننگز میں 316 رنز پر خاتمہ، پاکستان کو 90 رنز کا ہدف
stories.summary:
راولپنڈی میں کھیلے جانے والے ٹیسٹ میچ کے چوتھے روز سری لنکن ٹیم اپنی دوسری اننگز میں 316 رنز بنا کر آؤٹ ہوگئی، جس کے بعد میزبان ٹیم کو سیریز میں فتح حاصل کرنے کے لیے 90 رنز کا ہدف ملا ہے۔ چوتھے روز کے آغاز پر سری لنکا نے 309 رنز پر نو کھلاڑی آؤٹ کے ساتھ کھیل دوبارہ شروع کیا تھا، تاہم دن کے دوسرے ہی اوور میں محمد عباس نے اسیتھا فرنانڈو کو ایل بی ڈبلیو کر کے آخری وکٹ حاصل کی۔

مہمان ٹیم کی دوسری اننگز میں ملن رتھنائیکے نے 66 رنز کی ناقابل شکست اننگز کھیلی، جبکہ سونل دینوشا اور کوشال مینڈس بالترتیب 54 اور 53 رنز بنا کر نمایاں بلے باز رہے۔ پاکستان کی بولنگ سائیڈ کی طرف سے عامر جمال اور محمد عباس نے تین تین کھلاڑیوں کو آؤٹ کیا۔ اس کے علاوہ رضا اللہ نے دو جبکہ ثاقب خان اور سلمان علی آغا نے ایک ایک وکٹ اپنے نام کی۔

میچ کے ابتدائی مراحل میں سری لنکا کی پہلی اننگز صرف 98 رنز پر سمٹ گئی تھی، جس کے جواب میں پاکستانی ٹیم نے 325 رنز بنا کر تمام کھلاڑیوں کے آؤٹ ہونے پر 227 رنز کی بڑی برتری حاصل کی تھی۔ پاکستان کی پہلی اننگز میں غازی غوری نے 54، اذان اویس نے 47، طیب عارف نے 46 اور رضااللہ نے 42 رنز اسکور کیے تھے۔

پہلی اننگز میں سری لنکا کی جانب سے بولنگ کرتے ہوئے لاہیرو کمارا نے پانچ وکٹیں حاصل کی تھیں۔ اس کے علاوہ اسیتھا فرنانڈو نے تین، جبکہ ملن رتھنائیکے اور پرباتھ جے سوریا نے ایک ایک وکٹ حاصل کی تھی۔ اس میچ میں کامیابی حاصل کرنے کی صورت میں پاکستانی ٹیم کے لیے ہدف کا حصول اہمیت رکھتا ہے۔

stories.title: Ben Shelton Reaches ATP Finals Semifinals as Arthur Fils Exits
stories.summary:
American tennis player Ben Shelton secured his place in the ATP Finals semifinals on Thursday at the Inalpi Arena in Turin, Italy. Earlier in the day, the 24-year-old defeated Spain's Rafael Jodar with scores of 7-6 (10/8), 7-5 in their John McEnroe Group encounter. Jodar, a 20-year-old newcomer ranked 10th from Spain, held two set points during the opening set tie-break and later fought back from deficits in the second set before ultimately falling to his third defeat of the week in his debut at the elite season-ending tournament.

Shelton's progression to the final four was confirmed later when world number one Alexander Zverev defeated France's Arthur Fils in straight sets, winning 6-4, 7-6 (8/6) in 35 minutes for the first set. Zverev has not dropped a set in Turin and is guaranteed to win the group, putting him through alongside Shelton and Carlos Alcaraz. Zverev acknowledged battling a lingering ankle injury stemming from a 2022 French Open ligament tear, stating he will work with his physio and team to be ready for Saturday's match against the runner-up of Friday's fixture between Daniil Medvedev and Frances Tiafoe.

Meanwhile, world number three Carlos Alcaraz awaited the outcome of an MRI scan on Thursday following a hamstring injury sustained during his Wednesday victory over Russia's Daniil Medvedev. Alcaraz has also reached the tournament's final four with assistance from Tiafoe.

Reflecting on his match, Shelton praised Jodar as a formidable competitor possessing numerous weapons, while expressing satisfaction at overcoming difficult moments during the first set. Jodar expressed immense pride in his breakthrough season performance, emphasizing the high level of consistency required to compete against the world's top players.

stories.title: Pakistani Leaders Vow Dialogue Amid Political Tensions Over New Provinces
stories.summary:
Pakistan President Asif Ali Zardari and Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif agreed on Thursday to resolve all national issues through consultation and dialogue. The high-level meeting took place at the Aiwan-e-Sadr in Islamabad against the backdrop of rising political friction surrounding a recent debate over the creation of new administrative provinces.

The presidency stated that the leaders reviewed the overall national situation, the political landscape, and Middle East developments. The renewed commitment to consultation follows sharp remarks from Pakistan Peoples Party (PPP) Chairman Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari, who criticized federal ministers and opposed any forced division of Sindh, warning of severe unrest.

Federal ministers, including Minister of State for Interior Talal Chaudhry, responded by defending the necessity of governance reforms while emphasizing that all major decisions require consensus among allied parties. Chaudhry noted that the ruling coalition has historically made all legislative and administrative moves through joint committees and democratic processes.

Despite the friction, Bilawal has affirmed his continued support for Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif's government, stressing that the public expects leaders to prioritize economic solutions. The meeting between Zardari and Sharif underscores the ruling coalition's intent to manage internal disagreements democratically and prevent further escalation.

stories.title: پنجاب میں فضائی آلودگی خطرناک سطح پر، لاہور دنیا میں سرفہرست
stories.summary:
پنجاب بھر میں فضائی آلودگی کی صورتحال انتہائی سنگین شکل اختیار کر گئی ہے اور مختلف شہروں میں ایئر کوالٹی انڈیکس خطرناک حد کو چھو رہا ہے۔ عالمی درجہ بندی فراہم کرنے والے ادارے آئی کیو ایئر کے مطابق لاہور 368 اے کیو آئی کے ساتھ دنیا بھر کے شہروں میں پہلے نمبر پر رہا۔ اس کے علاوہ گوجرانوالہ میں آلودگی کی شرح 562 اور ملتان میں 524 ریکارڈ کی گئی ہے، جو شہریوں کی صحت کے لیے شدید خطرے کی علامت ہے۔

صوبائی ایئر کوالٹی ڈیش بورڈ کے اعداد و شمار کے مطابق صبح کے وقت جھنگ کا اے کیو آئی 441 اور لاہور کا 402 ریکارڈ کیا گیا۔ اس کے علاوہ شیخوپورہ میں 381، پاکپتن میں 356 اور ساہیوال میں 348 اے کیو آئی کے ساتھ صوبے کے آلودہ ترین شہروں میں شمار ہوئے۔ لاہور کے مقامی علاقوں میں بھی صورتحال انتہائی تشویشناک رہی جہاں ملتان روڈ، ڈی ایچ اے فیز 6 اور جی ٹی روڈ پر ایئر کوالٹی انڈیکس 500 تک جا پہنچا۔ اس کے علاوہ فیصل آباد میں 686 اور گوجرانوالہ میں 550 اے کیو آئی ریکارڈ کیا گیا۔

فضائی آلودگی میں اس خطرناک اضافے کی وجہ سے عام شہریوں بالخصوص بچوں، بزرگوں اور سانس کی بیماریوں میں مبتلا افراد کو شدید طبی خطرات لاحق ہو گئے ہیں۔ محکمہ صحت اور ماہرین نے ایسے تمام افراد کو گھروں میں رہنے اور شدید احتیاطی تدابیر اختیار کرنے کی ہدایت کی ہے تاکہ زہر آلود فضا کے مضر اثرات سے بچا جا سکے۔

stories.title: JPMorgan, Visa, and Mastercard Reveal Third-Party Vendor Cyberattacks
stories.summary:
JPMorgan Chase announced on Thursday that third-party service providers were targeted in a cyberattack, potentially exposing customer names and email addresses. A JPMorgan spokesperson stated that the company is investigating the incident and will contact affected customers directly. The bank clarified that this breach is unrelated to a software bug earlier in the week that caused transaction processing disruptions across multiple lenders.

In related developments, a cyber extortion group named "n0n" claimed responsibility on November 16 for acquiring cardmember records and data from Visa and Mastercard. A Visa spokesperson confirmed awareness of the claims, linking them to an Asia-Pacific third-party service provider while emphasizing that Visa's own systems and payment data, such as card numbers, remained unaffected. Similarly, a Mastercard spokesperson reported a limited exposure of email addresses for a small subset of cardholders enrolled in a specific benefit program at a third-party provider, noting no impact on the Mastercard payment network.

The compromised data attributed to these incidents includes marketing campaign details, phone numbers, postal codes, and employee email addresses from various global regions. The hacking group n0n has allegedly claimed approximately 200 incidents since emerging in September 2026. Experts note that these events highlight significant reputational risks for financial institutions, as customers often do not distinguish between a bank and its external vendors during a cyber incident.

stories.title: ملک کے مفاد میں بہتر فیصلہ ہو گا، طارق فضل چودھری
stories.summary:
وفاقی وزیر برائے پارلیمانی امور ڈاکٹر طارق فضل چودھری نے ایک بیان میں امید ظاہر کی ہے کہ صدر آصف زرداری اور وزیر اعظم شہباز شریف کی ملاقات کے بعد ملک کے مفاد میں مثبت فیصلے سامنے آئیں گے۔ انہوں نے واضح کیا کہ ریفرنڈم آئین میں ایک قانونی آپشن ہے جس کے ذریعے کسی متنازع معاملے پر براہِ راست عوامی رائے لی جا سکتی ہے، لیکن اس سے انتخابات کا مؤقف تبدیل نہیں ہوتا۔ ان کا کہنا تھا کہ موجودہ حکومت اپنی آئینی مدت پوری کرے گی اور مقررہ وقت پر ہی انتخابات کروائے جائیں گے۔

اس دوران سیاسی اور حکومتی امور کے حوالے سے مختلف شخصیات کے بیانات اور سرگرمیاں بھی سامنے آئی ہیں۔ رہنما پاکستان پیپلز پارٹی اور دیگر رہنماؤں نے مخصوص نشستوں اور قانون سازی پر ہونے والی مشاورت کا ذکر کیا۔ سندھ بلڈنگ کنٹرول اتھارٹی نے لیاقت آباد میں ایک عمارت کی غیر قانونی تعمیر کے معاملے پر مؤقف پیش کیا جبکہ بحیرہ عرب میں اسمگلنگ کی روک تھام کے لیے پاک بحریہ، میری ٹائم سیکیورٹی ایجنسی اور اے این ایف کی مشترکہ کارروائی عمل میں آئی۔

راولپنڈی اور لاہور کے حلقوں میں اہم ملاقاتیں اور عدلیہ کی کارروائیاں بھی جاری رہیں۔ جی ایچ کیو میں فیلڈ مارشل سید عاصم منیر سے قطر کے وزیر داخلہ شیخ خلیفہ بن حمد بن خلیفہ الثانی نے ملاقات کی، جس میں منشیات کے کیسز میں تعاون اور مختلف شعبوں میں اشتراکِ عمل پر گفتگو کی گئی۔ دریں اثنا، کوٹ لکھپت جیل لاہور میں قید پی ٹی آئی کی قیادت نے چیف جسٹس آف پاکستان اور چیف جسٹس اسلام آباد ہائیکورٹ کو ایک مشترکہ خط ارسال کیا جس میں سیاسی اسیران کے مقدمات پر تحفظات کا اظہار کیا گیا۔

مقدمات کی سماعت کے دوران پراسیکیوٹر نوید حسین نے عدالت کو بتایا کہ اس مقدمے میں اب تک سولہ گواہان کے بیانات ریکارڈ کیے جا چکے ہیں۔ دوسری جانب، کابینہ ڈویژن کے سیکریٹری نے ملک کو درپیش بحرانوں میں ڈیجیٹائزیشن کے فقدان کو ایک بڑی رکاوٹ قرار دیا۔ مہاجر قومی موومنٹ کے چیئرمین آفاق احمد نے بھی جنوبی سندھ صوبے کے قیام کو اپنی جماعت کا دیرینہ مطالبہ قرار دیا۔

stories.title: Trump Discloses Nvidia and SpaceX Stock Trades Made in September
stories.summary:
US President Donald Trump purchased between $200,000 and $265,000 worth of Nvidia stock and sold up to $15,000 in September, according to a financial disclosure released on Thursday. The transactions occurred shortly before media reports emerged regarding alleged ties between Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and a Chinese spy. These trades follow previous disclosures showing Trump bought up to $1.6 million and sold up to $1 million in Nvidia shares in August.

The financial disclosure, signed by Trump on November 1 and made public by the US Office of Government Ethics, also revealed that the president bought up to $315,000 in SpaceX stock in September. SpaceX is a US military contractor led by Elon Musk, a former adviser to Trump, and maintains substantial government contracts tied to federal agency approvals.

White House spokesperson Davis Ingle stated that third-party financial institutions independently manage the president's portfolio by replicating recognized indexes like the Schwab 1000. Ingle emphasized that neither Trump nor his family members possess the ability to direct or influence investment decisions or timing.

The disclosures arrive as the Trump administration weighs policies concerning advanced chip export rules for Nvidia, the world's leading maker of AI chips. Washington has increasingly sought to limit China's access to advanced computing technology to prevent its use in weapon development, while Chinese entities continue to seek access through third-party countries like Southeast Asian nations.

stories.title: Pakistan PM Credits Civil-Military Coordination for Economic Progress
stories.summary:
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif stated on Thursday that strong coordination between Pakistan's political and military leadership has fostered valuable opportunities for economic growth. Addressing the Pakistan-American Business Council (PABC), the premier emphasized that export-led growth is the sole sustainable path forward for the country's economy.

Hurrying to reassure domestic and foreign investors, Sharif highlighted improvements in key economic indicators. He noted that Pakistan's total foreign exchange reserves have risen to approximately $27 billion, inflation has dropped to 11.5% from a previous high of 32%, and the policy rate has been reduced to 12% from 23.5%. These gains reflect fiscal discipline and collective efforts following a severe threat of default in 2023.

The prime minister also outlined government initiatives aimed at empowering the private sector, streamlining export financing, and promoting electric vehicles to reduce fuel import dependence. He noted that agricultural sectors, including livestock, are being reformed with international consultants to transform the economy, while direct digital cash transfers have replaced outdated welfare distribution systems.

Leaders of the business council expressed strong investor confidence, noting that participating American companies have generated substantial cumulative revenues and capital investments over the past five years. Sharif assured investors that his administration remains dedicated to eliminating bureaucratic hurdles and addressing genuine grievances swiftly.

stories.title: پیرس ایئرپورٹ پر مشتبہ ڈرون کی اطلاع، پروازوں کا آپریشن عارضی معطل
stories.summary:
فرانس کے پیرس ایئرپورٹ پر فضائی حدود میں مشتبہ ڈرون کی موجودگی کی اطلاع ملنے کے بعد تمام پروازوں کی آمد و رفت کو عارضی طور پر روک دیا گیا۔ اس واقعے کے نتیجے میں مسافروں اور مختلف ایئرلائنز کو شدید پریشانی کا سامنا کرنا پڑا۔

حکام کو جیسے ہی ایئرپورٹ کے اوپر ڈرون دیکھے جانے کی اطلاع موصول ہوئی، انہوں نے فوری طور پر حفاظتی اقدامات نافذ کیے۔ ممکنہ خطرے کے پیش نظر ایئرپورٹ کی فضائی حدود اور اس کے اردگرد کے علاقوں میں تفصیلی سیکیورٹی چیکنگ کا آغاز کیا گیا۔

کلیئرنس ملنے کے بعد حکام نے کچھ ہی دیر میں پروازوں کا معمول کا آپریشن بحال کردیا۔ واضح رہے کہ فرانسیسی قوانین کے تحت ہوائی اڈوں اور حساس تنصیبات کے قریب بغیر اجازت ڈرون اڑانے پر سخت پابندی عائد ہے کیونکہ یہ طیاروں کی لینڈنگ اور ٹیک آف کے دوران بڑے حادثات کا سبب بن سکتے ہیں۔

ایئرپورٹ حکام نے اس واقعے کی باقاعدہ تحقیقات شروع کر دی ہیں۔ تاہم، جاری کردہ ابتدائی رپورٹ میں مشتبہ ڈرون یا اسے آپریٹ کرنے والے فرد کے حوالے سے مزید کوئی تفصیلات سامنے نہیں آ سکیں ہیں۔

stories.title: Global Leaders Issue Symbolic Peace Declaration at Historic Shenzhen Summit
stories.summary:
Chinese President Xi Jinping, US President Donald Trump, and Russian President Vladimir Putin convened for an unprecedented three-way summit in Shenzhen, China, on Thursday. During the meeting, the leaders issued a symbolic "peace declaration" reaffirming that a nuclear war cannot be won and must never be fought, though the agreement contained no formal arms-control commitments or reductions of nuclear arsenals. The three powers agreed to maintain dialogue on reducing nuclear risks and preventing proliferation without setting a specific timeline.

The declaration also addressed broader geopolitical issues, including pledges to advance United Nations reforms, increase fuel product supplies, and uphold the immunity of state officials in international courts. Notably, the document omitted any reference to Russia's ongoing war in Ukraine or the conflict with Iran. Putin described the summit as beneficial for addressing regional conflicts and gaining diplomatic credibility, while analysts noted the meeting caused unease among smaller nations and US European allies.

The summit concluded shortly before European leaders and Ukrainian officials were scheduled to meet Trump's envoys, Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, in Berlin. Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andriy Sybiha criticized the meeting's outcomes, asserting that Russia must end the war. Meanwhile, Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi maintained a distanced presence at the broader gathering following ongoing diplomatic friction with China over Taiwan.

The historic venue, Kylin Villa, has previously hosted sensitive diplomatic encounters. The trilateral meeting followed individual bilateral discussions held by Trump with both Xi and Putin during his three-day diplomatic tour across Asia.

stories.title: مسلم لیگ ن کا نئے صوبوں پر اتفاق رائے کے لیے سیاسی کمیٹی بنانے کا فیصلہ
stories.summary:
مسلم لیگ ن کی قیادت نے ملک کی موجودہ سیاسی صورتحال، نئے انتظامی یونٹس اور صوبوں کے قیام کے معاملے پر تمام پارلیمانی جماعتوں سے رابطہ کرنے کا فیصلہ کیا ہے۔ اس مقصد کے لیے ایک رابطہ کار سیاسی کمیٹی تشکیل دی جائے گی۔

یہ خصوصی کمیٹی پاکستان پیپلز پارٹی اور ایم کیو ایم پاکستان سمیت تمام پارلیمانی جماعتوں سے رابطے کرے گی۔ پارٹی ذرائع کے مطابق مرکزی قیادت آئندہ مجوزہ آئینی ترمیم، نئے صوبوں کے قیام، آئینی و قانونی امور اور ممکنہ عوامی ریفرنڈم کے معاملات کا باریک بینی سے جائزہ لے رہی ہے۔

ان تمام امور پر بحث کے لیے وفاقی حکومت کی جانب سے ایک قومی سیاسی کانفرنس بھی منعقد کی جا سکتی ہے، جس کے بعد اس لائحہ عمل کو پارلیمان میں پیش کیا جائے گا۔ اگر تمام فریقین میں اتفاق رائے پیدا ہو گیا تو ایک پارلیمانی کمیٹی تشکیل دے کر آئینی امور کو حتمی شکل دی جائے گی۔

اس پوری مشق کا مقصد ملک سے دہشت گردی کے خاتمے اور معیشت کو مضبوط بنانے کے لیے ایک مشترکہ حکمت عملی وضع کرنا ہے۔ سیاسی رابطوں کے دوران نئے صوبوں کے مجوزہ خاکے اور بلدیاتی نظام کے قیام کے معاملات بھی زیر غور لائے جائیں گے۔

stories.title: Anthropic Reaches $2 Trillion Valuation After Record $81.3 Billion IPO
stories.summary:
Anthropic debuted on the Nasdaq exchange at a $2 trillion valuation on Thursday after raising $81.3 billion in the largest stock-market listing in history. The AI lab, known for developing the Claude chatbot, priced its shares above the marketed range, making it the first publicly traded frontier artificial intelligence company. The milestone reflects intense investor demand for advanced AI technology following years of rapid sector growth and massive funding rounds.

The company's journey to the public market included significant financial backing from major technology players. Anthropic raised capital through multiple funding stages, including a $450 million investment involving Alphabet's Google and Spark Capital, up to $4 billion in cash commitments from Amazon.com, and an agreement for up to $2 billion from Google. Its valuation surged through successive rounds, reaching $380 billion before a subsequent $65 billion round valued the company at $965 billion ahead of its initial public offering.

Anthropic's rapid expansion also encountered legal and political friction. The startup faced a class-action lawsuit from authors alleging the misuse of books to train Claude, which culminated in a landmark $1.5 billion settlement approved by a federal judge in San Francisco. Additionally, the company navigated tensions with the US military after the Trump administration directed agencies to halt work with Anthropic and designated it a supply-chain risk, prompting Anthropic to file a lawsuit to block the national security blacklist.

Structured as a public benefit corporation, Anthropic is legally required to balance broader public interests with profitability. The record-breaking IPO establishes the firm as a dominant publicly traded force in the artificial intelligence industry, outperforming early institutional interest seen in other major listings.

stories.title: سابق وفاقی وزیر لیاقت عباس بھٹی کے قتل پر محافظوں سمیت 11 افراد کیخلاف مقدمہ
stories.summary:
حافظ آباد میں سابق وفاقی وزیر لیاقت عباس بھٹی کے قتل کے معاملے میں ایک بڑا انکشاف سامنے آیا ہے جہاں ان کے اپنے محافظ ہی مبینہ قاتل نکلے۔ پولیس نے اس بہیمانہ واقعے پر چار نامزد ملزمان سمیت کل 11 افراد کے خلاف قتل اور ڈکیتی کا مقدمہ درج کر لیا ہے۔

مقدمہ مقتول کے بھتیجے اور پنجاب اسمبلی کے رکن ضمیر الحسن بھٹی کی مدعیت میں درج کیا گیا۔ ایف آئی آر میں الزام عائد کیا گیا ہے کہ ملزمان نے لیاقت عباس بھٹی کو رسیوں سے باندھ کر گلا گھونٹ کر قتل کیا اور گھر سے 20 لاکھ روپے نقدی، 50 تولے طلائی زیورات، اے ٹی ایم کارڈ اور قیمتی دستاویزات لے کر فرار ہو گئے۔ نامزد ملزمان میں زاہد علی اور فرحان علی شامل ہیں جن کا تعلق ضلع صوابی سے بتایا گیا ہے، جبکہ ملزمان مقتول کی پراڈو، لینڈ کروزر اور ویگو ڈالا گاڑیاں بھی اپنے ساتھ لے گئے۔

ڈی پی او حافظ آباد فواد احمد کا کہنا ہے کہ ملزمان کی گرفتاری کے لیے مختلف مقامات پر چھاپے مارے جا رہے ہیں اور جائے وقوعہ سے ملنے والے شواہد کی روشنی میں جدید ٹیکنالوجی کی مدد سے تفتیش جاری ہے۔ لیاقت عباس بھٹی مسلم لیگ ق کے دور حکومت میں وفاقی وزیر رہے تھے اور دو مرتبہ رکن قومی اسمبلی اور ایک مرتبہ رکن پنجاب اسمبلی منتخب ہوئے تھے۔

مقتول کے دیگر عزیزوں میں سابق ارکان قومی اسمبلی مہدی حسن بھٹی اور شوکت علی بھٹی کے علاوہ پی ٹی آئی کی ایم این اے انیقہ مہدی حسن اور ایم پی اے ضمیر الحسن بھٹی شامل ہیں۔ مقتول کی نماز جنازہ آج سہ پہر تین بجے ان کے آبائی گاؤں برجدارا میں ادا کی جائے گی۔

stories.title: کراچی میں پولیس کے دو مبینہ مقابلے، تین زخمیوں سمیت پانچ ملزمان گرفتار
stories.summary:
کراچی کے مختلف علاقوں میں پولیس اور مبینہ ڈاکوؤں کے درمیان دو الگ الگ پولیس مقابلوں کے دوران تین زخمیوں سمیت پانچ ملزمان کو گرفتار کر لیا گیا۔ گرفتار کیے گئے ملزمان کے قبضے سے اسلحہ، موبائل فونز اور موٹرسائیکلیں برآمد کی گئی ہیں۔

پہلا مقابلہ تیموریہ پولیس اور ڈاکوؤں کے درمیان نارتھ ناظم آباد بلاک این میں واقع ڈینٹل کالج کے قریب پیش آیا، جہاں فائرنگ کے تبادلے کے بعد ایک زخمی سمیت دو ملزمان کو گرفتار کیا گیا۔ زخمی ملزم کی شناخت تیس سالہ احسن عباسی کے طور پر ہوئی جسے عباسی شہید اسپتال منتقل کیا گیا، جبکہ دوسرے ملزم احمد شجا کو تھانے منتقل کیا گیا۔ پولیس کے مطابق یہ ملزمان اسٹریٹ کرائم کی متعدد وارداتوں میں ملوث ہیں اور ان کا سابقہ کریمنل ریکارڈ بھی موجود ہے۔ ان کے قبضے سے اسلحہ، تین موبائل فون اور تیموریہ سے چوری شدہ موٹرسائیکل ملی ہے۔

دوسرا مقابلہ شارع نورجہاں پولیس اور ڈاکوؤں کے درمیان شادمان ٹاؤن سیکٹر چودہ بی میں ہوا جس کے نتیجے میں دو زخمیوں سمیت تین ملزمان گرفتار ہوئے۔ زخمی ملزمان کی شناخت آصف اور شایان کے ناموں سے ہوئی جنہیں اسپتال منتقل کیا گیا، جبکہ تیسرے ملزم کبیر کو تھانے منتقل کیا گیا۔

ابتدائی تفتیش سے انکشاف ہوا ہے کہ ان ملزمان نے گزشتہ روز حیدری مارکیٹ اور نارتھ ناظم آباد سے موٹرسائیکلیں چھینی تھیں، جبکہ برآمد ہونے والا ایک موبائل فون نو روز قبل احمد نامی شہری سے چھینا گیا تھا۔ پولیس دونوں واقعات میں گرفتار ملزمان سے مزید تفتیش کر رہی ہے اور برآمد شدہ سامان کے حوالے سے ریکارڈ چیک کیا جا رہا ہے۔

stories.title: Washington Spirit Set to Face Kansas City Current in NWSL Final
stories.summary:
The Washington Spirit are preparing to host the Kansas City Current in the National Women's Soccer League championship game on Saturday. Both teams are aiming to put recent playoff disappointments behind them, with Washington having finished as runners-up in each of the last two seasons, losing the 2024 final to the Orlando Pride and being defeated by Gotham FC the following year. The Spirit secured home-field advantage because the championship venue was awarded to Washington well before the finalists were determined. They will compete against a strong Current squad that recorded a league-leading 54 regular-season goals and reached the playoffs for the fourth time in six years while chasing their first trophy.

Washington's attack is spearheaded by star striker Trinity Rodman, who tallied 14 goals and 10 assists across the regular season and playoffs. Defensive midfielder Andi Sullivan has also emerged as a crucial player after missing the entire previous season due to an ACL tear and maternity leave. Spirit coach Adrian Gonzalez noted that past experiences have prepared his team better than in previous years. Meanwhile, Current coach Chris Armas plans to rely on two-time MVP Temwa Chawinga and Haley Hopkins in the offensive end, alongside a collective defensive strategy that held top-seeded Gotham to zero shots on target in the semi-final.

The upcoming championship marks another year of growth for the NWSL, with league commissioner Jessica Berman stating that average attendance has risen 40% since 2022, climbing from 7,800 to more than 11,000. However, the league faced logistical hurdles regarding venue availability during the semi-finals, as both home teams nearly faced displacement—including the Spirit, who were almost pushed out by a Division III collegiate football game. Berman highlighted that shared ownership with Major League Soccer teams, such as upcoming moves and expansion teams in cities like Atlanta and Columbus, could provide the league with greater scheduling influence in the future.

stories.title: Report Alleges Silicon Valley Elites Funded Pro-Israel Platform Visegrad24
stories.summary:
An investigative report published by American magazine Wired on Thursday revealed that the Polish right-wing news media platform Visegrad24 received substantial funding from Silicon Valley elites to establish a pro-Israel editorial stance. Founded in 2020 by Stefan Tompson, the platform gained massive traction on social media platform X following the October 7, 2023, attack by Hamas. Within three days, the account published nearly 400 posts consisting of news updates, tributes to victims, and videos of protests, which accumulated 370 million views and thrust the account into the spotlight as a prominent pro-Israel voice.

According to internal communications and financial records reviewed by Wired, Tompson deliberately weighed his options after the outbreak of the conflict, eventually choosing a pro-Israel stance because supporters possessed significant influence and money, with the explicit goal of fundraising off the issue. The investigation revealed that Tompson was added to exclusive communication groups, including one named Jewish Alliances and an informal WhatsApp thread comprising hundreds of powerful figures from Silicon Valley, Wall Street, and Hollywood. These networks worked to build support for Israel and reportedly contributed to significant fundraising success for Visegrad24 through major investment firms, donor-advised funds, and contributions from high-profile technology and business executives.

The donations included $175,000 from DonorsTrust, a fund closely aligned with the priorities of the Trump administration. The platform's founder utilized donor-advised funds, which allow contributors to remain anonymous. While individuals and entities named in the report either declined to comment, denied having donation records, or argued that Visegrad24 was not a far-right group, the platform managed to secure over a million dollars in donations. Previously known for its coverage of the Russian invasion of Ukraine and accusations of spreading misinformation, Visegrad24 later took positions on other geopolitical events, such as expressing enthusiasm for the restoration of Reza Pahlavi's leadership during attacks involving Israel and Iran.

stories.title: Zulfi Bukhari Recognized Among New Generation of Global Politicians
stories.summary:
British-Pakistani politician and former government minister Sayed Zulfikar Abbas Bukhari, known as Zulfi Bukhari, has been named by London-based publication The Luxurist among an international group of emerging political figures. The list, titled "The new generation of global politicians changing the face of power," highlights younger leaders who challenge traditional political structures and engage new voter demographics.

The magazine praised Bukhari for his international business background, cosmopolitan upbringing between London and Pakistan, and contemporary communication style.
