He stated that these conditions demand constant vigilance, strategic foresight, and operational readiness to counter conventional, hybrid, and asymmetric threats effectively.

stories.title: جامعہ کراچی کے شعبہ کیمسٹری میں دو جدید لیبارٹریز کا افتتاح کر دیا گیا
stories.summary:
جامعہ کراچی کے شعبہ کیمسٹری میں 1973 کے فارغ التحصیل طلبہ کی المنائی تنظیم کے تعاون سے قائم کردہ دو جدید لیبارٹریز کا باضابطہ افتتاح کر دیا گیا ہے۔ فیکلٹی آف سائنس کی ڈین پروفیسر ڈاکٹر بلقیس گل نے شعبہ کے سابق استاد شاہد احمد کے نام سے منسوب ان آرگینک کیمسٹری لیبارٹری اور ان کی شریکِ حیات مریم ایس ڈارسوٹ سے منسوب اینالیٹیکل کیمسٹری لیبارٹری کا افتتاح کیا۔ اس تقریب میں شعبہ کی چیئرپرسن پروفیسر ڈاکٹر نسرین فاطمہ سمیت ملک و بیرون ملک سے تعلق رکھنے والے متعدد ماہرین اور اساتذہ نے شرکت کی۔

شکاگو میں مقیم اسی بیچ کے مخیر طالب علم شاہد احمد کی مالی اعانت سے کیمسٹری ڈپارٹمنٹ کی تزئین و آرائش کا یہ منصوبہ "عزمِ عالی شان" کے نام سے نو ستمبر 2025 کو شروع کیا گیا تھا۔ اس منصوبے کے تحت دونوں عمارتوں کی مرمت، پانچ ہزار گیلن گنجائش کا زیرزمین پانی کا ٹینک، پانی اور گیس کی نئی پائپ لائنز، بجلی کے نئے تار، باتھ رومز کی جدید فٹنگز اور لیبارٹری کا نیا فرنیچر چین سے منگوایا گیا ہے۔ تقریب کے مقررین نے طلبہ کو محنت، لگن اور استقامت کے ساتھ تعلیم حاصل کرنے کی تلقین کی۔

ڈائریکٹر اوورسیز 1973 المنائی ڈاکٹر التفات حسن نے اپنے ویڈیو پیغام میں بتایا کہ یہ فلاحی پلیٹ فارم مستحق طلبہ کی فیسیں ادا کر رہا ہے اور سال 2026 میں پینتالیس بچوں کی فیس ادا کی گئی ہے تاکہ کوئی طالبعلم مالی مشکلات کی وجہ سے تعلیم ادھوری نہ چھوڑے۔ سابق عالمی اسکواش چیمپیئن جہانگیر خان نے بھی اپنے پیغام میں طلبہ کو مادرِ علمی کی خدمت کرنے کا درس دیا۔

تقریب میں اساتذہ نے اس بات پر زور دیا کہ طلبہ کیمیکلز کے محفوظ استعمال اور حفاظتی تدابیر سے مکمل آگاہی حاصل کریں تاکہ عملی زندگی میں وہ بہترین کارکردگی کا مظاہرہ کر سکیں۔ منتظمین کے مطابق اس جدید انفراسٹرکچر سے طلبہ کو تحقیق کے بہترین مواقع میسر آئیں گے اور وہ ملکی و بین الاقوامی سطح پر جامعہ کا نام روشن کرنے میں کامیاب ہوں گے۔

stories.title: کراچی میں دو مختلف حادثات کے دوران دو افراد ہلاک
stories.summary:
کراچی کے مختلفعلاقوں میں پیش آنے والے دو الگ الگ حادثات کے نتیجے میں دو افراد اپنی جان سے ہاتھ دھو بیٹھے۔ دونوں جاں بحق افراد کی لاشیں اسپتال منتقل کر دی گئی ہیں جہاں ضروری کارروائی عمل میں لائی گئی۔

پہلا واقعہ سکھن کے علاقے بھینس کالونی سٹی کٹ کے قریب پیش آیا، جہاں ایک نامعلوم گاڑی کی ٹکر سے پچپن سالہ امیر بخش شدید زخمی ہو کر جاں بحق ہو گیا۔ متوفی کی لاش کو شناخت کے لیے جناح اسپتال پہنچایا گیا، اور ایس ایچ او سکھن عرفان علی سہتو کے مطابق اس حادثے کے حوالے سے مزید تحقیقات جاری ہیں۔

دوسرا حادثہ سولجر بازار کے علاقے میں گارڈن نشتر روڈ پر واقع بانو پلازہ میں پیش آیا۔ یہاں پینتیس سالہ کاشف لد مرسلین عمارت کی چوتھی منزل سے نیچے گر گیا جس کے نتیجے میں وہ جاں بحق ہو گیا۔

حادثے کے بعد چھیپا ایمبولینس کے ذریعے متوفی کی لاش کو سول اسپتال منتقل کیا گیا۔ چھیپا ترجمان کے مطابق متوفی کے ورثا نے موت کی تصدیق کرنے کے بعد پولیس کارروائی کے بغیر ہی لاش خود وصول کر لی۔

stories.title: Pakistan and Qatar Deepen Bilateral Security and Counter-Terrorism Ties
stories.summary:
Pakistan and Qatar have formally reiterated their dedication to expanding bilateral collaboration within security, counter-terrorism, and institutional frameworks. The diplomatic development unfolded during a meeting in Rawalpindi between Pakistan's Chief of Defence Forces and Chief of the Army Staff, Field Marshal Asim Munir, and visiting Qatari Interior Minister Sheikh Khalifa bin Hamad bin Khalifa Al Thani.

During their discussions, the officials evaluated regional and global security dynamics alongside avenues for bolstering joint security initiatives. Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif also welcomed the Qatari minister on his maiden visit to Pakistan, where various cooperative agreements were finalized in the presence of the premier and Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi. These included a memorandum of understanding on security cooperation signed between Qatar's Lekhwiya internal security force and Pakistan's Federal Constabulary, alongside an action plan targeted at halting drug trafficking.

Additional institutional arrangements were agreed upon by the respective interior ministries to broaden police officer exchange programs and foster stronger coordination between Pakistan's National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency and Qatar's National Cyber Security Agency. Furthermore, Qatar committed to constructing a modern firing range at the National Police Academy, while ongoing joint operations have successfully suppressed numerous drug smuggling cases over recent years.

During the visit, Prime Minister Sharif acknowledged Qatar's consistent supply of liquefied natural gas to meet national energy demands and noted the significant contributions of the approximately 300,000 Pakistani expatriates residing in Qatar. Both governments emphasized mutual opportunities to expand economic cooperation into sectors such as trade, information technology, agriculture, livestock, and mining and minerals.

stories.title: بغیر سرجری دل کے علاج کیلئے جدید ای سی پی ٹیکنالوجی
stories.summary:
بغیر آپریشن بائی پاس یعنی ای سی پی ایک جدید ترین اور بغیر کسی کٹ یا سرجری کی ٹیکنالوجی ہے، جس کا بنیادی مقصد دل اور جسم کے دیگر تمام اعضاء میں خون کی گردش کو بحال اور تیز کرنا ہے۔ اس علاج کے دوران ٹانگوں پر خاص قسم کے کف کے ذریعے بیرونی دباؤ ڈال کر خون کا بہاؤ دل کی طرف بڑھایا جاتا ہے، جس سے دل کی نئی باریک رگیں کھلتی ہیں۔ ماہر امراض قلب ڈاکٹر شباہت علی کے مطابق یہ طریقہ علاج دل کے مریضوں کے لیے سائنسی معجزہ ہے اور جسم کی دیگر دائمی بیماریوں میں بھی انتہائی فائدہ مند ہے۔

یہ طریقہ علاج ان مریضوں کے لیے تجویز کیا جاتا ہے جو بائی پاس یا اسٹینٹنگ سے ڈرتے ہیں، جن کی شریانیں بہت زیادہ باریک ہوں، یا جو ہارٹ فیلیر اور ڈیفیوز بیماری کا شکار ہوں۔ ای سی پی کا مکمل کورس پینتالیس سیشنز پر مشتمل ہوتا ہے جو ہفتے میں پانچ دن، روزانہ ایک گھنٹے کی بنیاد پر کیا جاتا ہے۔ اس عمل کے دوران کوئی کٹ نہیں لگتا اور نہ ہی بیہوشی کی ضرورت ہوتی ہے۔

طبی شواہد کے مطابق اس تھراپی کے اسی فی صد سے زائد مثبت نتائج دیکھے گئے ہیں اور ایکو کارڈیوگرافی کے ذریعے دل کی پمپنگ پاور میں واضح بہتری کا جائزہ لیا جاتا ہے۔ پاکستان میں یہ سہولت شیخ زید اسپتال میں برانڈ نیو مشین کے ساتھ فراہم کی جا رہی ہے اور اس کورس کا خرچہ تقریباً ڈھائی سے تین لاکھ روپے کے قریب آتا ہے۔

ڈاکٹر شباہت علی کا کہنا ہے کہ جو مریض خوف، مالی تنگی یا طبی مجبوری کی وجہ سے سرجری نہیں کروا سکتے، ان کے لیے ای سی پی ایک محفوظ، مؤثر اور معجزاتی متبادل ہے۔ یہ علاج دل کے ساتھ ساتھ شوگر، گردوں اور فالج کے اثرات کو بہتر بنا کر مریض کو ایک توانا زندگی فراہم کرتا ہے، البتہ علاج کے بعد طویل المدتی فوائد کے لیے کارڈیک ری ہیب اور باقاعدہ دوائیوں کا استعمال ضروری ہے۔

stories.title: UN Rights Chief Volker Turk Urges Release of Imran Khan
stories.summary:
United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights Volker Turk called for the release of former Pakistani prime minister Imran Khan on Thursday, urging authorities to ensure his proper treatment and work toward political de-escalation. Imran and his wife, Bushra Bibi, are currently incarcerated at Rawalpindi’s Adiala Jail following a 17-year sentence handed down on December 20, 2025, in the Toshakhana-II case regarding the unlawful retention of a Bulgari jewellery set gifted by the Saudi crown prince. Imran has been detained since August 2023, serving a separate sentence in a £190 million corruption case while also facing pending anti-terrorism trials linked to protests on May 9, 2023.

Turk's appeal followed a warning from Imran that his health was deteriorating and that he might not survive his imprisonment unless top judges enforced court orders regarding his medical care. In a CNN interview, Turk suggested that Imran's immediate release could serve as a vital confidence-building measure between the government and the political opposition to diffuse tensions. The UN human rights chief emphasized the importance of respecting international legal standards governing detention, noting that human rights defenders, journalists, and other opposition members are also facing arbitrary detention in the broader political context.

In tandem with the UN's remarks, Amnesty International's South Asia Regional Office urged Pakistani authorities to provide adequate healthcare to both Imran and Bushra Bibi, restore regular access to family and legal counsel, and halt the political persecution of Imran's family. Amnesty stated that the 74-year-old former prime minister has been kept in solitary confinement, suffering from severe blood pressure issues, and denied access to independent doctors despite a Supreme Court order. The rights group also reported that Bushra Bibi is suffering from an eye condition threatening her eyesight, and highlighted the detention of several family members, including Imran's sister Aleema Khan, under the Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance.

stories.title: پی ٹی آئی خوش فہمی میں نہ رہے، مصطفیٰ کمال کا بیان
stories.summary:
متحدہ قومی موومنٹ پاکستان کے رہنما مصطفیٰ کمال نے ایک ٹی وی پروگرام میں گفتگو کرتے ہوئے کہا ہے کہ تحریک انصاف والے اس خوش فہمی میں بالکل نہ رہیں کہ بلاول بھٹو زرداری کا بیان ان کے لیے ہے، کیونکہ وہ کسی اور کو سنا رہے ہیں۔ انہوں نے کہا کہ چھبیسویں ترمیم میں بلدیاتی حکومت کے اختیارات مانگے گئے تھے لیکن پیپلز پارٹی نے انہیں بلڈوز کر دیا۔ انہوں نے تنقید کی کہ سندھ میں اٹھارہ سال سے ایک ہی پارٹی کی حکمرانی ہے اور بائیس ہزار ارب روپے خرچ ہونے کے باوجود کراچی سے گٹر میں بچہ گر کر مرنے کی خبریں آتی ہیں۔

پروگرام کے دوران دیگر سیاسی و عسکری امور پر بھی بات کی گئی جن میں بحیرہ عرب میں پاک بحریہ، میری ٹائم سیکیورٹی ایجنسی اور اے این ایف کی مشترکہ کارروائی شامل تھی۔ اس کے علاوہ، چیف آف ڈیفنس اسٹاف اور آرمی فیلڈ مارشل سید عاصم منیر سے قطر کے وزیر داخلہ شیخ خلیفہ بن حمد بن خلیفہ الثانی نے جی ایچ کیو میں ملاقات کی، جس میں غذائی تحفظ، موسمیاتی تبدیلی، آئی ٹی اور تعلیم کے شعبوں میں تعاون بڑھانے پر گفتگو کی گئی۔

دوسری جانب، کوٹ لکھپت جیل لاہور میں قید پی ٹی آئی کی قیادت بشمول شاہ محمود قریشی، یاسمین راشد، عمر سرفراز چیمہ، اعجاز چوہدری اور میاں محمود الرشید نے چیف جسٹس آف پاکستان اور چیف جسٹس اسلام آباد ہائیکورٹ کو ایک مشترکہ خط لکھا ہے۔ خط میں مؤقف اختیار کیا گیا ہے کہ سیاسی رہنماؤں کو بغیر ٹھوس شواہد کے مقدمات اور سزاؤں کا سامنا کرنا پڑ رہا ہے، اور اتنی بڑی تعداد میں سیاسی قیدی پہلے نہیں دیکھے گئے۔

علاوہ ازیں، مہاجر قومی موومنٹ کے چیئرمین آفاق احمد نے کہا ہے کہ جنوبی سندھ صوبے کا قیام ان کے منشور کا حصہ ہے اور یہ مطالبہ کسی کی ایما پر نہیں بلکہ قوم کی خواہش پر ہونا چاہیے۔ ناروے میں پاکستان کے سفیر عاصم علی خان نے بھی اوسلو میں مختلف ممالک کے سفیروں سے ملاقاتیں کیں، جبکہ سندھ بلڈنگ کنٹرول اتھارٹی نے لیاقت آباد میں غیر قانونی تعمیر کے ایک کیس میں عدالت کو بتایا کہ بلڈر کو گراؤنڈ پلس فائیو کی اجازت دی گئی تھی۔

stories.title: قطری وزیر داخلہ کی جی ایچ کیو آمد، آرمی چیف فیلڈ مارشل عاصم منیر سے ملاقات
stories.summary:
قطر کے وزیر داخلہ شیخ خلیفہ بن حمد بن خلیفہ الثانی نے جی ایچ کیو میں چیف آف ڈیفنس فورسز اور آرمی چیف فیلڈ مارشل سید عاصم منیر سے ملاقات کی۔ ملاقات کے دوران علاقائی اور عالمی سیکیورٹی صورتحال، دو طرفہ سیکیورٹی تعاون بڑھانے اور باہمی دلچسپی کے امور پر تفصیلی تبادلہ خیال کیا گیا۔ اس موقع پر سیکیورٹی اور انسداد دہشت گردی کے شعبوں میں تعلقات مزید بہتر بنانے اور ادارہ جاتی تعاون کو مضبوط بنانے کے عزم کا اعادہ کیا گیا۔

قطری وزیر داخلہ نے خطے میں امن اور استحکام کے فروغ کے لیے پاکستان کی خدمات اور کردار کی تعریف کی۔ دوسری جانب فیلڈ مارشل عاصم منیر نے قطر کے ساتھ دوطرفہ رابطوں کو مزید گہرا کرنے کے عزم کا اظہار کیا اور دونوں ممالک کے سامنے موجود مشترکہ سیکیورٹی چیلنجز سے نمٹنے کی خاطر قریبی تعاون کی اہمیت پر زور دیا۔

ملاقات میں سلامتی کے امور کے علاوہ غذائی تحفظ، موسمیاتی تبدیلی، انفارمیشن ٹیکنالوجی اور تعلیم جیسے اہم شعبوں میں بھی اشتراکِ عمل کو مزید وسعت دینے پر بات چیت کی گئی۔ یہ اعلیٰ سطح کا رابطہ دونوں برادر ملکوں کے درمیان سیکیورٹی اور ترقیاتی امور میں بڑھتی ہوئی شراکت داری کی عکاسی کرتا ہے۔

stories.title: پاکستان اور قطر کا پولیس آفیسرز ایکسچینج پروگرام بڑھانے پر اتفاق
stories.summary:
وفاقی وزیر داخلہ محسن نقوی اور قطر کے وزیر داخلہ شیخ خلیفہ بن حمد نے ایک اہم ملاقات میں پولیس آفیسرز ایکسچینج پروگرام کا دائرہ کار بڑھانے پر اتفاق کیا ہے۔ اعلامیے کے مطابق اس ملاقات کے دوران قطر کی نیشنل سائبر سیکیورٹی ایجنسی اور این سی سی آئی اے کے مابین تعاون میں مزید اضافہ کرنے کا فیصلہ بھی کیا گیا۔

ملاقات میں یہ بھی طے پایا کہ قطر نیشنل پولیس اکیڈمی میں ایک جدید فائرنگ رینج تعمیر کرے گا۔ وزیر داخلہ محسن نقوی نے فائرنگ رینج کے قیام میں تعاون پر قطری ہم منصب کا شکریہ ادا کیا۔ انہوں نے بتایا کہ دونوں ممالک کی ایجنسیوں کے درمیان جاری مشترکہ آپریشنز اور معلومات کے تبادلے کے نتیجے میں گزشتہ چار برسوں کے دوران منشیات کے 300 کیسز پکڑے گئے ہیں۔

قطری وزیر داخلہ نے پاکستان اور قطر کی وزارت ہائے داخلہ کے باہمی تعاون کو ایک مثالی رشتہ قرار دیا اور اس عزم کا اظہار کیا کہ اس تعاون کو مزید مضبوط اور وسیع بنایا جائے گا۔ یہ اشتراک دونوں ملکوں کے قانون نافذ کرنے والے اداروں کے درمیان گہرے ہوتے تعلقات کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے۔

stories.title: Schools Across Five Countries Win Prestigious Global Education Prizes
stories.summary:
Educational institutions in Britain, Nigeria, Brazil, Pakistan, and South Korea have been named winners of the World’s Best School Prizes on Thursday. The awards recognize excellence in areas such as supporting student well-being, helping underserved communities, and coordinating care for children with complex learning needs. Winning schools are invited to attend the World Schools Summit in London in January to present their educational approaches to policymakers.

The announcement arrived shortly after student protests regarding school renovations, teacher shortages, and the cost of living occurred in France. Vikas Pota, founder of T4 Education and the prizes, noted that the winning institutions offer students hope for a secure future while directly responding to community needs.

Among the victors, the Swiss Cottage School, Development and Research Centre in London won the Community Collaboration prize for integrating education, therapy, and healthcare to assist lower-income pupils with complex learning needs. In Nigeria, the Slum2School Green Academy in Epe earned the Environmental Action prize for its solar-powered, natural-material infrastructure and sustainability-focused curriculum serving children from river communities. Escola Municipal GET IV Centenario, a public primary school located within a Rio de Janeiro favela, captured the Overcoming Adversity prize for its creativity-focused learning model implemented despite local violence closing the campus for 37 days in 2024.

Additional awards included the Supporting Healthy Lives prize granted to TNS Beaconhouse in Lahore for supporting neurodivergent learners, and the Innovation prize awarded to Seoul's G-School for student-led social problem-solving projects. Separately, Istanbul's Darussafaka Egitim Kurumlari won the public-voted Community Choice award for providing a full-scholarship boarding program that includes remote learning for earthquake-affected children.

stories.title: International Schools Win World's Best School Prizes for Community Work
stories.summary:
Schools located in Pakistan, Britain, Nigeria, Brazil, and South Korea received the World’s Best School Prizes on Thursday in recognition of their efforts to enhance student well-being, aid underprivileged communities, and assist children with complex learning challenges. Organizers from the global educator network T4 Education announced that all winning institutions will be invited to participate in the World Schools Summit in London this coming January.

The annual awards announcement coincides with student demonstrations in France where high school pupils protested building conditions, teacher shortages, and living costs. T4 Education founder Vikas Pota stated that the awarded schools are actively addressing community demands and providing young people with optimism regarding their futures.

Specific category winners include the Swiss Cottage School in London, which secured the Community Collaboration award for combining education with healthcare and therapy services for disadvantaged pupils with complex needs. The Slum2School Green Academy in Epe, Nigeria, captured the Environmental Action prize by operating a solar-powered facility built from natural materials that teaches river community children about renewable energy and waste management. In Rio de Janeiro, Escola Municipal GET IV Centenario received the Overcoming Adversity prize for maintaining an innovative learning model despite being forced to close for 37 days in 2024 due to regional violence.

Further accolades were distributed to TNS Beaconhouse in Lahore, which won the Supporting Healthy Lives award for its dedication to neurodivergent learners, and G-School in Seoul, which earned the Innovation prize for student-led community accessibility projects. Additionally, Istanbul's Darussafaka Egitim Kurumlari boarding school won the public-decided Community Choice award for offering remote learning solutions to children impacted by earthquakes.

stories.title: Federal Constitutional Court Sets Aside Provincial Infrastructure Cess Rulings
stories.summary:
The Federal Constitutional Court (FCC) of Pakistan on Thursday set aside high court rulings that had previously upheld the infrastructure cess levied by the governments of Sindh and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. A two-judge bench, headed by FCC Chief Justice Aminuddin Khan and including Justice Aamer Farooq, reviewed a batch of 568 petitions filed by private litigants. The petitioners challenged previous decisions by the Sindh High Court and the Peshawar High Court, which had validated the Sindh Development and Maintenance of Infrastructure Cess Act, 2017, and the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Infrastructure Development Cess Act, 2022, along with subsequent amendments introduced through the KP Finance Act, 2024.

During the proceedings, the court examined the constitutional boundaries of provincial taxation concerning imports, exports, customs transactions, and the inter-provincial movement of goods. Petitioners argued that provincial legislatures lacked the constitutional authority to impose fiscal levies on items falling within the federal legislative domain, thereby encroaching upon Parliament's exclusive powers. Senior counsel Hafiz Ehsaan Ahmad Khokhar, representing the Revenue Division and the Federal Board of Revenue, supported this stance by pointing to Articles 141 and 142(a) of the Constitution, alongside specific entries in the Federal Legislative List that assign customs duties and inter-provincial trade exclusively to the federation. He argued that the true nature of a fiscal levy operating through customs clearance cannot be altered simply by labeling it an infrastructure cess.

In contrast, the provincial governments of Sindh and KP defended their respective laws as legitimate provincial levies designed to finance local road networks and infrastructure development under Article 142(c). The additional attorney general also supported the federal position that the provinces lacked the legislative competence to enact such levies. After hearing the arguments, the FCC nullified the two high court judgments, declaring that the provincial legislations exceeded the constitutional authority of the provincial assemblies.

stories.title: COP31 Negotiators Remove Fossil Fuel References From Revised Draft Deal
stories.summary:
Climate negotiators at the COP31 summit in Antalya, Turkiye, published a slimmed-down draft deal that omitted any language regarding ending the use of fossil fuels. The revised text also removed a $120 billion target for adaptation finance aimed at helping developing nations deal with climate impacts. The ongoing talks are taking place as policymakers face competing pressures from global conflicts and rising living costs alongside worsening environmental disasters like heatwaves, floods, and droughts.

Mohamed Adow, director of the Power Shift Africa think tank, criticized the new text for moving backward and warned that the summit could become a ghost COP with nothing substantial to show. Despite the cuts, the Thursday draft maintained an acknowledgment that global temperature increases might exceed the 1.5 degrees Celsius threshold and highlighted the necessity for rapid greenhouse gas emission reductions. It also supported the deployment of carbon removal technologies, which scientists argue are vital for lowering atmospheric temperatures.

The document introduced a goal to increase electricity's share of global energy consumption to 35 percent by 2035, up from the current 23 percent, to help slash emissions. However, this target previously faced resistance from developing nations over funding concerns, and the host country's goal has only secured backing from roughly 75 countries. Jasper Inventor of Greenpeace raised concerns that the electrification target lacked clarity and that carbon removal mentions could enable the fossil fuel industry to continue polluting.

Australia is leading the negotiations alongside Turkiye under a split presidency arrangement. While the official conference deadline is set for Friday, consensus efforts among the nearly 200 participating countries frequently exceed the deadline by more than a day. Participants widely accept the need to limit rising temperatures, yet deep divisions remain over the exact methods, financial responsibilities, and the required speed of global action.

stories.title: Pakistan to Attend SCO Civilisations Forum in New Delhi
stories.summary:
A Pakistani delegation led by Federal Minister for Climate Change and Environmental Coordination Dr Musadik Masood Malik will attend the first Shanghai Cooperation Organisation Civilisations Dialogue Forum in New Delhi. The event is scheduled to take place from November 20 to 22. This visit marks the first trip to India by a Pakistani federal minister since May 2023, when then foreign minister Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari traveled to Goa for an SCO foreign ministers meeting.

The upcoming visit occurs against the backdrop of strained diplomatic relations between Islamabad and New Delhi. Both nations have been in a diplomatic stalemate following a four-day military confrontation in May 2025. Relations previously deteriorated after 26 people were killed in Indian Illegally Occupied Jammu and Kashmir, an attack New Delhi blamed on Pakistan while Islamabad denied any involvement.

According to the Foreign Office, Dr Malik is attending the forum at the invitation of India's Minister of Culture and Tourism. During the event, he will present Pakistan's perspective on inter-civilisational dialogue and highlight the country's diverse cultural heritage and constructive role within the SCO. The Foreign Office noted that participation reflects Pakistan's ongoing commitment to fostering cooperation in alignment with the "Shanghai Spirit."

On the sidelines of the forum, the delegation will engage in thematic sessions and meet with representatives from other SCO member states. Pakistan currently holds the rotating chair of the SCO Council of Heads of State for the 2026-27 term. In this leadership capacity, the country is set to host various ministerial and expert group gatherings leading up to next year's summit.

stories.title: Turkish Energy Minister Arrives in Karachi for Offshore Exploration Mission
stories.summary:
Turkish Energy Minister Alparslan Bayraktar arrived in Karachi with a delegation ahead of the impending arrival of Turkiye's seismic research vessel, Oruç Reis. Federal Minister for Petroleum Ali Pervaiz Malik, Petroleum Secretary Hamed Yaqoob Sheikh, and Sindh Minister Syed Zulfiqar Ali Shah welcomed the Turkish delegation at the airport, marking a new phase in bilateral energy cooperation between the two nations.

The Oruç Reis is scheduled to dock at Karachi port before initiating a seismic survey to evaluate potential oil and gas reserves in Pakistan's offshore waters. This deployment represents Pakistan's first major initiative to revive offshore exploration activities in two decades, following the launch of the Offshore Bid Round 2025 last January after an 18-year hiatus. The bid round offered exploration licenses across 40 offshore blocks situated in the Indus and Makran basins off the coasts of Sindh and Balochistan.

During the bidding process, the Turkish Petroleum Corporation secured a 25 percent stake and operatorship in Offshore Block-C. A recent basin study conducted by the US-based consultancy DeGolyer and MacNaughton identified substantial unexplored hydrocarbon potential in these regions, prompting the Pakistani government to invite companies to explore various geological prospects.

For the initial three-year license period, participating companies have committed 4,427 work units involving an estimated expenditure of $80 million focused on geological and geophysical studies. If initial findings prove promising and lead to exploration drilling, the total investment under the program is projected to escalate between $750 million and $1 billion according to the Petroleum Division.

stories.title: وزیراعظم شہباز شریف کی آسیان سیکرٹری جنرل سے اہم ملاقات
stories.summary:
وزیراعظم شہباز شریف سے آسیان کے سیکرٹری جنرل ڈاکٹر کاؤ کم ہورن نے ملاقات کی، جس میں تجارت، سرمایہ کاری اور اقتصادی تعاون کو فروغ دینے کے امور پر تفصیلی تبادلہ خیال کیا گیا۔ ملاقات کے دوران غذائی تحفظ، موسمیاتی تبدیلی، انفارمیشن ٹیکنالوجی اور تعلیم کے شعبوں میں اشتراکِ عمل کو مزید وسعت دینے پر بھی گفتگو کی گئی۔

اس موقع پر وزیراعظم شہباز شریف نے اس بات پر زور دیا کہ موجودہ خیر سگالی کے تعلقات کو ٹھوس اقتصادی اور ترقیاتی شراکت داری میں تبدیل کیا جانا چاہیے۔ انہوں نے پاکستان کے اسٹریٹجک محل وقوع اور خطے کے گیٹ وے کے طور پر اس کی صلاحیت کو اجاگر کرتے ہوئے کہا کہ پاکستان کے ذریعے علاقائی روابط، تجارت اور اقتصادی انضمام کو فروغ ملے گا۔ آسیان کے سیکریٹری جنرل نے پاکستان کے ساتھ تعلقات کو مزید مضبوط بنانے کے لیے آسیان کے پختہ عزم کا اعادہ کیا۔

اس کے علاوہ مختلف سیاسی اور انتظامی امور پر بھی رہنماؤں کے بیانات سامنے آئے ہیں۔ طارق فضل چودھری نے ریفرنڈم کے مقصد پر بات کی جبکہ طلال چوہدری نے گورننس کی بہتری کے لیے انتظامی یونٹس کا ذکر کیا۔ بحیرہ عرب میں اسمگلنگ کے خلاف پاک بحریہ، میری ٹائم سیکیورٹی ایجنسی اور اے این ایف نے مشترکہ کارروائی کی۔ 

جی ایچ کیو میں چیف آف ڈیفنس اسٹاف اور آرمی চিফ فیلڈ مارشل سید عاصم منیر سے قطر کے وزیر داخلہ شیخ خلیفہ بن حمد بن خلیفہ الثانی نے ملاقات کی۔ محسن نقوی نے بتایا کہ دونوں ملکوں کے تعاون سے گزشتہ چار سال میں منشیات کے 300 کیسز پکڑے گئے ہیں۔ کوٹ لکھپت جیل لاہور میں قید پی ٹی آئی قیادت نے چیف جسٹس آف پاکستان اور چیف جسٹس اسلام آباد ہائیکورٹ کو خط لکھ کر سیاسی رہنماؤں کو بغیر شواہد کے مقدمات کا سامنا کرنے سے آگاہ کیا۔

stories.title: گروپ کیپٹن عاصم طارق قتل کیس میں تین مزید گواہوں کے بیانات قلمبند
stories.summary:
اسلام آباد کی انسدادِ دہشتگردی کی عدالت میں گروپ کیپٹن شہید عاصم طارق کے قتل سے متعلق مقدمے کی سماعت ہوئی۔ اس دوران استغاثہ کے مزید تین گواہوں کے بیانات باضابطہ طور پر قلمبند کیے گئے۔ اے ٹی سی جج ابوالحسنات ذوالقرنین نے اس مقدمے کی باقاعدہ سماعت کی اور عدالتی کارروائی آگے بڑھائی۔

عدالتی کارروائی کے دوران پراسیکیوٹر نوید حسین نے عدالت کو آگاہ کیا کہ اس اہم مقدمے میں اب تک مجموعی طور پر سولہ گواہان اپنے بیانات ریکارڈ کروا چکے ہیں۔ عدالت نے آئندہے والی سماعت پر دفاعی وکلا کو ان گواہان پر جرح مکمل کرنے کی ہدایت جاری کی ہے۔

عدالت نے استغاثہ کے بقیہ تمام گواہان کو بھی آئندہ تاریخ پر طلب کر رکھا ہے۔ اس سلسلے میں عدالت نے گواہان کو تئیس نومبر کو پیش ہونے کا حکم دیا ہے تاکہ کیس کی کارروائی کو مزید آگے بڑھایا جا سکے اور فیصلے کی طرف قدم بڑھایا جا سکے۔

stories.title: Pakistan and Asean Agree to Strengthen Non-Traditional Security Cooperation
stories.summary:
Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar and Asean Secretary General Dr Kao Kim Hourn agreed on Thursday to enhance bilateral cooperation in addressing non-traditional security challenges. During delegation-level talks held at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in Islamabad, the two leaders focused on strengthening political, economic, socio-cultural, and technological ties, marking the first visit by an Asean secretary general in over two decades.

At a joint press stakeout, DPM Dar highlighted that discussions covered climate change, food insecurity, energy supply disruptions, and cyber threats as critical areas for joint action. Economic cooperation, trade facilitation, regional connectivity, and digital integration were emphasized to generate job opportunities and build stronger markets between Pakistan and Asean member states. Both sides also discussed bolstering academic linkages, research institutions, and youth exchanges in digital technologies and artificial intelligence, alongside promoting secure sea routes and uninterrupted supply chains.

Geopolitical and regional security issues were also addressed during the meetings. Dar briefed Dr Hourn on the Jammu and Kashmir dispute in line with UN Security Council resolutions, expressed concern over India's decision regarding the Indus Water Treaty, and raised worries regarding the use of Afghan soil for terrorist attacks. Furthermore, Dar discussed the humanitarian crisis in Gaza, West Bank settlements, and Pakistan's support for an independent Palestinian state. Dr Hourn acknowledged Pakistan's constructive role in regional peace, stability, and recent mediation efforts, including facilitating the Islamabad Memorandum of Understanding between the US and Iran in June.

During a separate meeting with Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif, discussions centered on transforming existing goodwill into concrete economic partnerships, leveraging Pakistan's strategic geographic location. Dr Hourn encouraged Pakistan to utilize Asean centres for capacity building and technical cooperation, emphasizing renewable energy, counter-terrorism, and crime prevention as vital areas for future collaboration.

stories.title: پنجاب اسمبلی کا نیا تھیٹر قانون اور اس پر اٹھنے والے اعتراضات
stories.summary:
پنجاب اسمبلی نے کثرت رائے سے ’دی پنجاب ڈرامیٹک اینڈ تھیٹریکل پرفارمنس 2026‘ بل منظور کر لیا ہے، جس کے تحت صوبے میں فنکاروں کی رجسٹریشن، سکرپٹ کی پیشگی منظوری، تھیٹرز کے لائسنس اور پرفارمنسز کی نگرانی کو لازمی قرار دیا گیا ہے۔ ضابطوں کی خلاف ورزی کرنے پر لاکھوں روپے جرمانے اور چھ ماہ تک کی قید کی سزا دی جا سکتی ہے۔ نئے قانون کے مطابق فحش، ہتک آمیز، مذہبی جذبات مجروح کرنے والی یا حکومت کے خلاف نفرت پیدا کرنے والی پرفارمنسز پر پابندی ہوگی۔

ہیومن রাইটস کمیشن آف پاکستان (ایچ آر سی پی) نے اس قانون کو فنکارانہ آزادی اور اظہار رائے کی سنگین خلاف ورزی قرار دیا ہے۔ کمیشن کا کہنا ہے کہ اس بل کا مقصد حکومت کو طنز و تنقید سے بالاتر بنانا اور فنون لطیفہ پر ریاستی کنٹرول کو مضبوط کرنا ہے۔ اپوزیشن ارکان نے بھی اس قانون کو شدید تنقید کا نشانہ بناتے ہوئے کہا ہے کہ اس سے قوالی اور ڈھول بجانے والے سمیت ہر فنکار سرکاری کنٹرول میں آ جائے گا، اور فیسوں کی ادائیگی فنکاروں کے لیے مالی مشکلات پیدا کرے گی۔

صوبائی وزیرِ اطلاعات و ثقافت عظمیٰ بخاری نے بل کا دفاع کرتے ہوئے کہا کہ حکومت کا مقصد پابندیاں لگانا نہیں بلکہ تھیٹر انڈسٹری کو ریگولیٹ اور منظم کرنا ہے۔ انہوں نے کہا کہ نامور فنکار معیاری ماحول نہ ہونے کی وجہ سے تھیٹر چھوڑ چکے ہیں۔ قانون کے تحت حکومت سکرپٹ ریویو کمیٹیاں قائم کرے گی اور پرفارمنس سے 15 روز قبل سکرپٹ جمع کرانا لازمی ہوگا۔

مجوزہ قانون کے مطابق تمام فنکاروں، ڈائریکٹرز اور پروڈیوسرز کو سرکاری طور پر رجسٹرڈ ہونا پڑے گا اور پرفارمنس کی فل ڈریس ریہرسل سینسر کمیٹی کو دکھانا ہوگی۔ منتظمین کو پروگرام کی ویڈیو ریکارڈنگ کم از کم 30 دن تک محفوظ رکھنا ہوگی اور لائیو الیکٹرانک نگرانی کی سہولت بھی فراہم کرنا ہوگی۔ خلاف ورزی پر تین لاکھ سے دس لاکھ روپے تک جرمانہ اور قید کی سزائیں تجویز کی گئی ہیں۔

stories.title: MQM-P Urges Action on Bilawal's Remarks Amid New Provinces Debate
stories.summary:
Muttahida Qaumi Movement-Pakistan Chairman Dr Khalid Maqbool Siddiqui announced that his party has been advised to reconsider its planned November 29 rally in Karachi. Speaking at a press conference in Karachi on Thursday, Siddiqui stated that law enforcement agencies reviewed local law and order concerns, prompting the party to consult further before announcing a new date for the event. The rally on Sharea Faisal was initially organized to advocate for new administrative units.

The political debate intensified following remarks by Pakistan Peoples Party Chairman Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari. Addressing an event on November 17, Bilawal expressed support for creating provinces based on constitutional law and public will, but warned that any forced partition of Sindh would provoke bloodshed. Concurrently, Sindh Taraqi Pasand Chairman Dr Qadir Magsi planned a counter-rally in Karachi on the same day to oppose the division of Sindh.

Siddiqui criticized Bilawal's statements, urging him and other opponents to engage in constitutional dialogue rather than issuing threats. He maintained that administrative units like provinces should be established based on population across the entire country, pointing out that the 1973 Constitution grants the federal government the authority to create new provinces. Siddiqui argued that urban areas in Sindh were raising a nationwide issue and questioned why new provinces are considered feasible in Punjab but met with resistance in Sindh.

During the presser, the MQM-P leader also challenged the country's feudal political structure and the provincial quota system in Sindh. He noted that poverty statistics showed declines across three of Pakistan's provinces while lagging behind in Sindh. Siddiqui emphasized that his party seeks a legal and constitutional resolution through discussion rather than conflict.

stories.title: Elon Musk Regrets Massive Midterm Spending After Republican Defeats
stories.summary:
Tesla and SpaceX CEO Elon Musk stated on Wednesday that he felt foolish regarding the scale of financial resources he deployed for the United States midterm elections. Speaking virtually at the New York Times DealBook Summit, the billionaire noted that campaign spending failed to yield expected outcomes after Republican candidates suffered widespread losses across the country.

Musk invested nearly half a billion dollars to support Republican candidates and maintain conservative control in Texas, a key state housing Tesla, SpaceX, and a planned chipmaking collaboration between the two companies. Those electoral bets collapsed as Democrats captured both chambers of Congress. Additionally, Democrat Gina Hinojosa defeated Republican incumbent Greg Abbott in the Texas gubernatorial race, delivering a notable setback to US President Donald Trump, whom Musk previously supported and closely allied with.

Reflecting on the results, Musk admitted that if he could rewind the clock, he would have spent significantly less money, conceding that election outcomes cannot be determined by campaign cash alone. While he suggested Republican candidates might have performed even worse without his financial backing, he acknowledged not seeing much tangible return for his substantial investment.

Transitioning to his artificial intelligence ventures, Musk discussed Anthropic's operations, stating it was extremely likely the firm would continue renting computing capacity from SpaceX while seeking an additional 10 gigawatts of computing capacity as the highest-probability outcome.

stories.title: Pakistan and 14 Nations Applaud UK and Australia Sanctions on Israeli Settlements
stories.summary:
Pakistan and 14 other countries formally welcomed the decisions made by the governments of the United Kingdom and Australia to enact targeted sanctions against entities and individuals involved in Israeli settlement expansion within the occupied West Bank. The joint statement was released by the Foreign Offices and foreign ministers representing Pakistan, Jordan, Egypt, Saudi Arabia, Somalia, Indonesia, Qatar, UAE, Türkiye, Kuwait, Algeria, Niger, Palestine, Libya, and the Maldives.

The UK announced sanctions on eight Israeli construction firms engaged in West Bank settlement construction, alongside measures targeting an organization obstructing humanitarian aid deliveries to Gaza. Australia similarly imposed targeted sanctions on three individuals and four organizations, marking its first punitive actions against a construction company tied to illegal settlement expansion and human rights abuses against Palestinians. The measures incorporate asset freezes and director disqualifications for firms like Har Hevron Development Company Ltd, Hemdat Shomron Ltd, and S.A.G. (Velvel) Construction and Development Ltd.

The allied foreign ministers condemned ongoing Israeli settlement policies, specifically highlighting the E1 settlement plan designed to divide the occupied West Bank and separate it from East Jerusalem. They expressed hope that international actors would follow the UK and Australia's lead, noting these actions align with international law, United Nations Security Council Resolution 2334, and the July 2024 Advisory Opinion of the International Court of Justice regarding the illegality of the occupation.

Additionally, the joint statement condemned the military escalation in Gaza, emphasized that Gaza remains an integral part of the Occupied Palestinian Territory, and called for the full implementation of President Trump's Comprehensive Plan to End the Conflict. The ministers reiterated that a just, lasting, and comprehensive peace requires realizing the two-state solution based on pre-1967 borders with East Jerusalem as the capital.

stories.title: Afaq Ahmed Demands Bilawal Bhutto Apologize for Hurting Muhajir Sentiments
stories.summary:
Muttahida Qaumi Movement (MQM) Chairman Afaq Ahmed has publicly demanded an apology from Pakistan Peoples Party (PPP) Chairman Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari. Speaking at a press conference, Ahmed stated that Bilawal's recent remarks caused distress to the Muhajir community. He warned that while his community remembers historical eras such as those of Gohar, Ayub, and Mumtaz Bhutto, they have never been intimidated by force.

Ahmed alleged that the PPP was raising the division issue to cover up its own corruption and accused the party of issuing threats aimed at inciting bloodshed in Karachi. He maintained that his party seeks a separate province for urban areas and advocated for the implementation of the urban-rural division previously established during the Bhutto era.

Addressing local political activities, Ahmed urged Khalid Maqbool Siddiqui to cancel a planned gathering on Shahrah-e-Faisal scheduled for November 29 to prevent confrontations, while still emphasizing the importance of protecting community dignity and neighborhoods. He asserted that the longstanding demand for new provinces does not require a referendum, though his community would participate in one if conducted constitutionally. Furthermore, Ahmed stressed that transparent elections and a fair census in Karachi represent the true path forward for national development.

This dispute matters because it highlights deep-seated political and ethnic tensions in Sindh regarding urban representation, provincial autonomy, and governance. The controversy underscores ongoing friction between regional political factions over administrative boundaries and community rights in Karachi.

stories.title: US, China, and Russia Sign Peace Declaration at APEC Summit
stories.summary:
Chinese President Xi Jinping, US President Donald Trump, and Russian President Vladimir Putin convened for an unprecedented trilateral meeting at Kylin Villa on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Summit in Shenzhen, China. During the historic gathering, the leaders of the world's largest nuclear powers agreed to a "peace declaration" affirming that a nuclear war must never be fought. The document was simultaneously released by Chinese state news agency Xinhua and the Kremlin.

In addition to the nuclear stance, the declaration outlines pledges to advance reforms within the United Nations, increase refined petroleum supplies globally, and uphold state officials' immunity in international courts. While Trump and Putin highlighted shared interests in resolving regional conflicts like the war in Ukraine, Xi emphasized broader harmony among major powers to maintain global peace. The trilateral discussion occurred amidst existing global tensions regarding trade, technology restrictions, and conflicts such as the war involving Iran.

Before the joint meeting, Trump held separate bilateral talks with Xi and Putin, noting his friendly and respectful relationships with both leaders. The summit drew attention from smaller nations concerned about potential disregard for their interests, while other APEC leaders engaged in separate diplomatic meetings. The leaders also participated in the traditional APEC group photo session.

This agreement matters as a rare display of diplomatic engagement among major global nuclear powers despite deep-seated geopolitical differences. The trilateral pact and its declarations on international governance and security set a significant tone for international relations and regional conflict resolution.

stories.title: Denmark Unanimously Ratifies Security Pact With US Over Greenland
stories.summary:
Denmark's parliament unanimously ratified a defense and security agreement with the United States regarding Greenland on Thursday. The move aims to resolve a lengthy diplomatic standoff and mend transatlantic relations that were severely strained after US President Donald Trump repeatedly threatened to seize control of the mineral-rich Danish self-governing territory, which has a population of 57,000. US Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated that the executive agreement modernizes the trilateral defense partnership between the US, Denmark, and Greenland, while bolstering national security for NATO allies.

The pact will take effect once Denmark's foreign ministry issues a diplomatic note confirming completion of procedures, bypassing the need for approval from the US Senate. It expands the American military footprint in Greenland by granting permission to establish a "Golden Dome" missile defense system and plan two new military bases, while formally reaffirming Danish sovereignty and Greenlanders' right to self-determination. Danish Defence Minister Jeppe Bruus noted that signatories will begin drafting a new Greenland law to vet foreign investors on security grounds and clarify the framework for the new military facilities.

Tensions escalated in January when President Trump refused to rule out using economic or military force to acquire the island. Naaja Nathanielsen, a Greenlandic member of the Danish parliament, remarked that the pressure created deep distrust among locals over the past two years, though she hopes the treaty initiates constructive dialogue. Greenland's own parliament ratified the agreement earlier in the month.

While Danish lawmakers expressed relief, political experts offer mixed perspectives on the long-term impact. Copenhagen University professor Mikkel Vedby Rasmussen suggested the treaty grants the US greater influence over security decisions and resource extraction. Conversely, other analysts note the agreement adds limited new military access, considering an existing northernmost US base is already situated on the island along the shortest route between Europe and North America. Controversy also surrounds recent statements by President Trump regarding imminent massive resource exploration, as Greenland maintains a strict ban on new crude drilling and Denmark insists local laws must be respected.

stories.title: Islamabad Court Sends 40 Accused to Jail in Bani Gala Cyber Fraud Case
stories.summary:
An Islamabad court has remanded 40 individuals, including one foreign national, to judicial custody in connection with the Bani Gala cyber fraud case. Judicial Magistrate Malik Aman presided over the hearing and approved a request from the National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency (NCCIA) to send 36 of the suspects to jail on judicial remand, while also rejecting a 28-day physical remand request for the remaining four suspects and sending them to jail as well.

During the proceedings, the investigating officer detailed that the cyber fraud operations involved coordinated groups where foreign nationals collaborated with Pakistani citizens. According to the investigator, victims were targeted through online dating applications and subsequently swindled under the guise of financial investment opportunities. In a separate recent operation, the NCCIA also arrested Muhammad Hashim Tahir in Lahore's Johar Town following an FBI complaint coordinated through the US Embassy, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and the Ministry of Interior regarding online sexual exploitation and threats directed at a nine-year-old girl in the United States.

These developments highlight ongoing law enforcement efforts in Pakistan to crack down on transnational digital crimes, ranging from financial scams to child exploitation. The strict judicial actions underline the growing legal scrutiny facing cybercrime networks operating within the country with international connections.

stories.title: Privicisation Commission Signs Financial Advisory Pact for Karachi and Lahore Airports
stories.summary:
The Privatisation Commission and a consortium led by EY Middle East have signed a financial advisory services agreement (Fasa) in Islamabad regarding the outsourcing of Jinnah International Airport in Karachi and Allama Iqbal International Airport in Lahore. The formal signing ceremony was witnessed by Muhammad Ali, Adviser to the Prime Minister on Privatisation and Privatisation Commission Chairman, alongside senior commission officials. The EY team was represented at the event by Andre Olivenca of EY International and Zeeshan Hussain.

Under the terms of the agreement, the EY-led consortium will deliver comprehensive transaction advisory services encompassing technical, financial, legal, environmental, and commercial expertise. These services are designed to support the structuring and implementation of the outsourcing transactions through a transparent, competitive, and market-driven process adhering to international best practices. The primary objective of the initiative is to introduce private sector expertise for the operation, management, commercial development, and optimization of both airports via concession or management contracts.

The outsourcing initiative forms part of the government's broader privatisation programme, initially decided under Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif in December 2022 to involve public-private partnerships. The process later shifted from a government-to-government framework to open bidding to ensure transparency and fair competition. Both major airports are anticipated to attract over $500 million each in fresh investments, contributing to enhanced efficiency, service quality, and long-term sustainability for passengers.

stories.title: EY-Led Consortium Hired to Advise on Karachi and Lahore Airports
stories.summary:
Pakistan has appointed an Ernst & Young Middle East-led consortium to provide financial advisory services for outsourcing operations at Jinnah International Airport in Karachi and Allama Iqbal International Airport in Lahore. The Privatisation Commission and the consortium formally signed a Financial Advisory Services Agreement in Islamabad on Thursday. The initiative aims to bring private sector expertise into the country's aviation sector through concessions or management contracts, allowing private operators to manage, develop, and commercially optimize both facilities.

The chosen consortium will deliver comprehensive transaction advisory support covering technical, financial, legal, environmental, and commercial domains. Officials stated that the process follows a transparent, competitive, and market-driven approach in line with international best practices. Muhammad Ali, chairman of the Privatisation Commission and special adviser to the prime minister, witnessed the signing alongside senior officials, while Andre Olivenca and Zeeshan Hussain represented the EY team.

This outsourcing effort is part of a broader national privatisation strategy linked to Pakistan's $7 billion International Monetary Fund program. The government believes private investment will improve service delivery and alleviate financial burdens on public funds. Karachi and Lahore airports are each projected to attract over $500 million in fresh investments. Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif previously approved master plan expansions for both airports on October 29.

Privatization efforts extend to other infrastructure sectors as well, including a separate concession process for Islamabad International Airport advised by the Asian Development Bank. Additionally, the government is pursuing private sector involvement for three electricity distribution companies operating in Islamabad, Faisalabad, and Gujranwala, following successful steps to transition Pakistan International Airlines management to a private consortium.

stories.title: Pakistan Stock Exchange Closes Higher as KSE-100 Gains Points
stories.summary:
Trading at the Pakistan Stock Exchange ended in positive territory on Thursday, November 19, 2026. The benchmark KSE-100 Index advanced by 477.86 points, representing a 0.27 percent increase, to settle at 176,772.19 points following a previous close of 176,294.33 points.

During the trading session, the index fluctuated, touching a high of 177,929.61 points and a low of 176,596.78 points. Market breadth on the Ready Market showed 242 companies advancing, 229 declining, and 28 remaining unchanged out of a total of 499 listed companies.

Trading activity on the regular market recorded a total turnover of 724,776,429 shares, down from the 742,121,491 shares logged in the preceding session. Concurrently, the total traded value dropped to Rs. 21,153,112,291 compared with Rs. 25,974,606,526 previously.

Despite the lower turnover and traded value, overall market capitalization expanded. Total market capitalization rose to Rs. 19,232,952,945,482, marking an increase from the Rs. 19,197,669,341,296 recorded during the prior trading session.

stories.title: Lahore Officially Assumes ECO Tourism Capital Designation for 2027
stories.summary:
Lahore has officially taken on the title of Economic Cooperation Organisation Tourism Capital for 2027. The formal handover ceremony took place in Shusha, Azerbaijan, which held the designation for 2026, with ECO Secretary General Ambassador Asad Majeed Khan transferring the title to Punjab Tourism, Archaeology and Museums Secretary Socrat Aman Rana.

Senior Punjab Minister Marriyum Aurangzeb hailed the recognition as international validation of Lahore's deep cultural and historical significance. The designation is intended to boost provincial efforts to leverage tourism for economic expansion, job creation, and investment through regional cooperation and international engagement.

As the 2027 tourism capital, Lahore is slated to host a year-long roster of international events, cultural festivals, and heritage celebrations. Proposed activities include regional tourism engagements, international delegations, the Basant festival, the Lahore Biennale, and various contemporary arts events to draw visitors from across the region.

Chief Minister Maryam welcomed the title, describing Lahore as a living embodiment of history and civilization. This announcement follows Lahore's selection in September as the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation's Tourism and Cultural Capital for 2026-27 during a meeting in the Kyrgyz capital.

stories.title: Pew Projects Muslims Will Outnumber Christians Globally by Year 2035
stories.summary:
Muslims are projected to surpass Christians as the world's largest religious group by 2035, according to demographic research published by the Pew Research Center. Driven by higher fertility rates and a younger median age, the global Muslim population is expected to grow by 80 percent between 2020 and 2070, potentially reaching over 3.6 billion.

By 2070, Muslims are anticipated to comprise 36 percent of the global population, up from 26 percent in 2020. Conversely, the Christian share is expected to remain relatively stable at about 29 percent, with numbers approaching 3 billion. Growth among major religious groups is primarily fueled by births rather than adult conversions, with Muslim women averaging 3.1 children between 2020 and 2025.

Sub-Saharan Africa will see major demographic shifts, with more than half of the world's Christians living in the region by 2070, and the Democratic Republic of the Congo projected to surpass the United States in Christian population. In North America, the Christian majority is expected to decline, while Europe will see its Muslim share approximately double to 13 percent due to migration.

Other groups will experience varied trajectories. Hindus and Jews will decline as a share of the global population, while Buddhists will shrink in both total number and share. The religiously unaffiliated population is projected to drop from 24 percent in 2020 to 17 percent in 2070, largely driven by China's anticipated population decline.

stories.title: UN Top Court Rules Myanmar Committed State-Sponsored Genocide Against Rohingya
stories.summary:
The highest court of the United Nations issued a historic ruling on Thursday, declaring that Myanmar security forces committed state-sponsored genocide against the Muslim Rohingya minority in 2017. Presiding Judge Yuji Iwasawa stated that the panel found Myanmar guilty of mass executions of men and boys, widespread sexual violence, extreme violence against children, and the burning of hundreds of villages in Northern Rakhine State. The military also actively spread hate speech targeting the population.

Brought by Gambia seven years prior, the case marks only the fourth time an international court has met the legal threshold to prove genocide since the Nazi Holocaust, and the first time a state has been held directly responsible. Judges concluded that the military offensive drove at least 700,000 Rohingya from Buddhist-majority Myanmar, noting that the actions reflected an intention to destroy a substantial part of the protected group.

The final and unappealable ruling mandates that Myanmar compensate the Rohingya and permit the safe and dignified return of displaced individuals and families. The International Court of Justice decision is expected to have broad international repercussions, including for South Africa's separate case accusing Israel of genocide in Gaza.

While ICJ rulings are final and binding, the court has extremely limited enforcement capabilities. Legal experts will carefully examine the verdict because it represents the first major decision on the 1948 Genocide Convention in over a decade, offering crucial insight into how international tribunals assess state responsibility for grave crimes.

stories.title: Sri Lanka Fights Back to Delay Pakistan Victory in Second Test
stories.summary:
Sri Lanka produced a resolute batting performance on Thursday, reaching 309-9 by stumps on the third day of the second and final Test against Pakistan at the Rawalpindi Cricket Stadium. Resuming their second innings at 74-3 and still trailing by 153 runs, the visiting team batted through all three sessions to establish an 82-run lead. The gritty effort successfully avoided an innings defeat and delayed Pakistan's victory charge.

The revival was spearheaded by Milan Rathnayaka, who remained unbeaten on 60, alongside half-centuries from Kusal Mendis and Sonal Dinusha. After losing early morning wickets, including Dhananjaya de Silva for 37 and Pasindu Sooriyabandara for 38, Kusal and Dinusha teamed up for a crucial 81-run partnership for the sixth wicket. Kusal contributed 53 runs before playing a sweep shot onto his stumps off Salman Agha.

Dinusha continued the resistance by scoring 54 runs before being caught by Azan Awais off Aamer Jamal, who was the pick of the Pakistan bowlers with figures of 3-67. Rathnayaka then reached his second Test half-century, supported by Asitha Fernando, who was not out on two when bad light ended play at 4:35 pm. Pakistan's bowling attack was hampered by a hamstring injury to fast bowler Saqib Khan, who was unable to bowl on the third day.

With only one wicket remaining, Pakistan remains firmly in control of the match and needs a single breakthrough to wrap up the innings before beginning their target chase. Sri Lanka, meanwhile, will look to squeeze whatever advantage they can from their narrow lead as the match nears its conclusion.

stories.title: Financial Stocks Push Sri Lankan Shares Upward in Thursday Trading
stories.summary:
Sri Lankan equities finished Thursday's trading session slightly higher, bolstered by gains in the financial sector. The Colombo Stock Exchange All-Share index recorded a 0.66 percent increase to settle at 21,543.12 points. Financial institutions Commercial Bank of Ceylon and Hatton National Bank drove the modest market growth, posting respective share price increases of 0.94 percent and 0.95 percent.

Despite the positive movement in the primary index, overall market activity experienced a downturn compared to the previous session. Trading volume contracted significantly to 53.8 million shares, down from 95.2 million shares during the prior day of trading. Financial turnover similarly decreased, dropping to 1.73 billion Sri Lankan rupees, equivalent to approximately $5.20 million, compared to 1.93 billion rupees previously.

Market data indicated a distinct divergence in participation between domestic and foreign investors. Foreign institutional and individual investors acted as net sellers, offloading shares with a total value of 134.7 million rupees. In contrast, domestic investors provided strong local support, functioning as net buyers by purchasing equities valued at 1.69 billion rupees during the session.

stories.title: Pakistan Nears Victory in Rawalpindi Despite Sri Lankan Lower-Order Resistance
stories.summary:
Pakistan remained on the brink of victory in the second Test against Sri Lanka at Rawalpindi Cricket Stadium, despite a determined lower-order fightback that pushed the visitors to 309-9 by stumps on Thursday. Carrying a 227-run deficit from the first innings, Sri Lanka avoided an innings defeat and built an 82-run lead, largely due to resistance from Milan Rathnayake, who finished the day unbeaten on 60.

Morning sessions saw early breakthroughs for the Pakistan pace attack. Aamer Jamal removed Dhananjaya de Silva lbw for 37, while Razaullah dismissed Pasindu Sooriyabandara caught-behind for 38. However, Kusal Mendis and Sonal Dinusha steadied the innings with an 81-run partnership. Kusal compiled 53 runs from 126 deliveries before playing a sweep shot onto his stumps off Salman Ali Agha. Dinusha followed with a resilient 54 runs from 119 balls before falling to a pull shot off Jamal, giving the bowler figures of 3-67.

Rathnayake then partnered with the tail, bringing up his second Test half-century and continuing to attack alongside Asitha Fernando, who was not out on two. Mohammad Abbas provided valuable support with the ball, taking 2-54 from 33 overs, which included 15 maidens. Pakistan's bowling depth was tested after fast bowler Saqib Khan sustained a left hamstring strain, ruling him out of further bowling duties in the match.

Bad light forced an early end to the day's play at 4:35 pm, leaving Pakistan just one wicket away from concluding the innings. The hosts will enter the final stages requiring only a modest target chase to secure a definitive result in the second and final Test.

stories.title: پیو ریسرچ سینٹر کی تحقیق: 2070 تک پاکستان سب سے بڑا مسلم ملک بن جائے گا
stories.summary:
پیو ریسرچ سینٹر کی ایک نئی تحقیق کے مطابق دنیا بھر میں مسیحیوں کے مقابلے میں مسلمانوں کی آبادی زیادہ تیزی سے بڑھ رہی ہے، اور 2070 تک پاکستان انڈونیشیا کو پیچھے چھوڑ کر دنیا کا سب سے بڑا مسلم اکثریتی ملک بن جائے گا۔ اس تحقیق میں 201 ممالک اور خطوں کے اعداد و شمار استعمال کیے گئے ہیں تاکہ آئندہ 50 برسوں کی مذہبی ساخت کا تخمینہ لگایا جا سکے۔

جنوبی ایشیا میں بڑی آبادیاتی تبدیلیاں متوقع ہیں جہاں پاکستان کی مسلم آبادی بڑھ کر 46 کروڑ 10 لاکھ ہو جائے گی، جبکہ بھارت میں مسلمانوں کی تعداد تقریباً 33 کروڑ 40 لاکھ تک پہنچ جائے گی۔ بھارت آنے والی دہائیوں میں ہندو اکثریتی ملک رہے گا جہاں 2070 تک ہندو آبادی 76 فیصد اور مسلمانوں کا تناسب 20 فیصد ہو جائے گا۔ اس تبدیلی کی بنیادی وجہ مسلمانوں کی نسبتاً کم عمر اور زیادہ شرحِ پیدائش ہے۔ ماہرین کے مطابق مذہبی تبدیلیوں کا یہ رجحان کسی ڈرامائی تبدیلی کی بجائے آبادیاتی رفتار کا نتیجہ ہے۔

عالمی سطح پر 2035 تک مسلمانوں کی تعداد مسیحیوں سے زیادہ ہو جائے گی اور وہ دنیا کا سب سے بڑا مذہبی گروہ بن جائیں گے۔ 2070 تک مسلمانوں کی تعداد بڑھ کر 3.64 ارب ہو جائے گی جو کل انسانیت کا 36 فیصد حصہ ہوں گے۔ افریقہ کے سب صحارا خطے میں مسیحیت کا مرکزِ ثقل منتقل ہو رہا ہے اور توقع ہے کہ جمہوریہ کانگو مسیحی آبادی کے لحاظ سے امریکہ کو پیچھے چھوڑ دے گا۔

دوسری طرف یورپ میں مسیحی آبادی میں سب سے زیادہ کمی متوقع ہے، اور امریکہ بھی 2065 تک اپنی مسیحی اکثریت کھو سکتا ہے۔ اس کے علاوہ خود کو کسی مذہب سے وابستہ نہ رکھنے والے افراد کی تعداد میں بھی تبدیلیاں آئیں گی، جبکہ چین میں آبادی میں کمی کی وجہ سے عالمی سطح پر غیر مذہبی آبادی کے تناسب میں کمی کی پیش گوئی کی گئی ہے۔

stories.title: Federal Government Raises Petrol Price by Re1 to Rs323
stories.summary:
The federal government increased the price of petrol by Re1 per litre on Thursday, bringing the new rate to Rs323. According to an Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority press release, the adjustment took effect for November 20. Meanwhile, the price of high-speed diesel remained unchanged at Rs355 per litre amidst ongoing economic adjustments in the country's energy sector.

Earlier in the month, authorities announced that domestic oil refineries would absorb a monthly burden of Rs15 billion. This measure allowed petrol to be sold at a discount of Rs15 per litre compared to global market rates during the US-Israeli conflict involving Iran. To manage global fuel market volatility driven by geopolitical tensions, the administration previously shifted from weekly to daily price reviews in July.

Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif also introduced a special relief scheme on September 13 to protect low-income households from soaring fuel costs. The initiative offers a monthly discount of Rs100 per litre on specific fuel quotas for approximately 11.8 million beneficiaries, covering motorcycles, three-wheeler rickshaws, and small cars with engines up to 800cc.

In addition to pricing adjustments, the government implemented strict fuel conservation and austerity measures in September. Under directives from the Cabinet Division, commercial venues such as markets, shopping malls, and general stores must close by 9pm daily, while wedding halls face a 10pm curfew and restaurants are permitted to operate until 11pm.

stories.title: Sindh Minister Sharjeel Memon Accuses MQM-P of Plotting Unrest
stories.summary:
Sindh Senior Minister Sharjeel Inam Memon asserted during a press conference in Karachi on Thursday that the Muttahida Qaumi Movement-Pakistan had prepared a conspiracy to trigger riots in the province. Speaking after a provincial cabinet meeting, Memon stated that the government had received indications of a plan to create disturbances and maintained that authorities would firmly deal with any threat to law and order. He emphasized that the administration was not intimidated by MQM-P and would prevent the situation from deteriorating.

The tensions escalated after a nationalist party and MQM-P both announced separate demonstrations at the same location for November 29. Memon explained that the provincial government wished to avoid political confrontation and decided against granting permission to any party to hold rallies on that date. A committee will engage with both MQM-P and nationalist groups to urge them to reconsider their plans, while reiterating that the creation of new provinces should be handled through parliament rather than street protests.

During his address, Memon criticized MQM-P by alleging that it held an unfair mandate and lacked support from the citizens of Karachi. He defended the Pakistan Peoples Party, declaring that his party had never engaged in violent politics or handled weapons. Furthermore, he addressed the unrest following Benazir Bhutto's assassination in December 2007, characterizing those events as natural public reactions rather than acts involving PPP workers.

Meanwhile, financial markets in the country experienced positive momentum as trading at the Pakistan Stock Exchange concluded on Thursday. The benchmark KSE-100 Index advanced by 477.86 points, representing a 0.27 percent increase, to settle at 176,772.19 points. This followed a previous close of 176,294.33 points according to the daily market report issued by the exchange.

stories.title: Copper Recovers From Seven-Month Low Amid Strong Demand From China
stories.summary:
Copper prices rebounded from a seven-month low on Thursday as bargain hunters entered the market, focusing heavily on strong demand from China. Benchmark copper on the London Metal Exchange recorded a 0.7 percent increase, reaching $12,558 per metric ton by 1138 GMT. This recovery follows a sharp 16 percent drop from a record high of $14,875 per ton touched in September, which had been driven partly by lower-than-expected artificial intelligence-related demand and algorithmic selling triggered by breached support levels.

 Chinese demand emerged as a dominant theme in the market, highlighted by the Yangshan copper premium reaching a record high of $360 per ton. Additionally, inventories in warehouses monitored by the Shanghai Futures Exchange dropped to a three-year low of 27,642 tons. These stocks have declined by 94 percent since March due to producers and traders shipping the metal to the United States ahead of potential import tariffs. George Griffiths from AMT Futures noted that this American effort to secure supply may encourage similar actions globally, creating a scarcity that provides a solid price floor.

 Concurrently, concerns regarding aluminium supplies pushed the premium for cash over the three-month forward to a 38-year high of $256.50 per ton, with three-month aluminium rising 0.7 percent to $2,843 per ton. Other industrial metals experienced mixed results, as zinc climbed 1.6 percent to $3,540, lead slipped 0.3 percent to $1,860, tin fell 1.6 percent to $42,125, and nickel retreated 1.2 percent to $15,660.

 Analysts point out that broader macroeconomic factors continue to exert pressure on dollar-priced metals. Specifically, a strong United States currency driven by expectations of higher US interest rates is expected to weigh on market valuations moving forward.

stories.title: Trump Says US Will Assess Iran Conflict Status After January 1
stories.summary:
United States President Donald Trump stated in broadcast remarks on Thursday that the US would evaluate its ongoing conflict with Iran after January 1, without clarifying the significance of the specific date. Throughout recent weeks, Trump has shifted between threatening escalation and suggesting potential de-escalation while a diplomatic standoff persists between the two nations regarding efforts to resolve hostilities.

During an interview with Fox News while traveling in China, Trump was questioned about a recent CNN report indicating that Iran planned to detonate a dirty bomb in Washington. He downplayed the prospect of a radioactive attack using conventional explosives, stating he did not believe capital residents should be alarmed. However, he also claimed there were indications that Tehran was exploring chemical and biological weapons, remarking that they are looking into gases and bio-agents since nuclear options have been blocked.

The Iranian Foreign Ministry did not immediately respond to requests for comment, though a ministry spokesman previously dismissed the CNN report as baseless. Western nations, the US, and Israel have consistently accused Iran of pursuing nuclear weapons, a claim Tehran denies. Dismantling Iran's nuclear program served as a primary justification for US and Israeli military strikes launched against the country in February.

In related developments, Israeli officials reported sharing intelligence with Washington over the past two weeks regarding Iran's military capabilities and chemical weapons development. Israeli Mossad chief Roman Gofman visited the US to advocate for renewed joint military strikes against Iran. Meanwhile, US Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated on Wednesday that he did not perceive any imminent threat to the American capital.

stories.title: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif Attributes Economic Successes to Civil-Military Partnership
stories.summary:
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif stated on Thursday that Pakistan's recent economic achievements stem from a productive partnership between the political leadership and the military hierarchy. Addressing an American Business Council of Pakistan event, the premier emphasized that such teamwork and flexibility in the national interest had no precedent in the country's history. He credited Chief of Defence Forces and Chief of Army Staff Field Marshal Asim Munir alongside his team, noting that a similar collaboration earlier in history could have completely transformed the nation.

Reviewing macroeconomic indicators, the prime minister recalled that Pakistan faced a severe threat of default in 2023 but achieved stability despite regional crises, such as the disruptions in the Gulf. He highlighted that despite importing over 90 percent of its energy needs, the country avoided fuel shortages and successfully implemented the Prime Minister’s Fuel Relief Scheme to protect vulnerable citizens. Regarding the Middle East conflict, he affirmed that Pakistan was actively engaged with Tehran and Washington alongside friendly nations to restore regional peace.

Addressing the business community, PM Shehbaz promised to remove impediments and enhance transparency for investors. He noted that the government provided tax breaks worth Rs400 billion in the previous budget to stimulate exports, manufacturing, and the salaried class despite operating under an International Monetary Fund program. Furthermore, he highlighted potential in the country's trillion-dollar mineral deposits and questioned the national interest in perpetually subsidizing the auto industry instead of embracing modern electric vehicle technologies.

Concluding his remarks, the prime minister stressed that the government enacted difficult decisions and structural reforms to stabilize the economy. He maintained that the current objective is to consolidate these gains and steer Pakistan toward sustained, export-led growth to secure its standing globally.

stories.title: Pakistan and Qatar Sign Security MoU and Drug Smuggling Plan
stories.summary:
Pakistan and Qatar signed a memorandum of understanding on security cooperation alongside an action plan aimed at preventing drug smuggling. The agreement was finalized between Qatar’s Internal Security Force, known as Lekhwiya, and Pakistan’s Federal Constabulary. The signing ceremony took place in Pakistan and was witnessed by Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif. Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi and his visiting Qatari counterpart, Sheikh Khalifa bin Hamad bin Khalifa Al Thani, officially executed the documents during the visit.

Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif warmly welcomed the Qatari dignitary on what marked his first visit to the country. The prime minister reaffirmed longstanding brotherly relations and expressed hope that the visit would strengthen institutional cooperation between the interior ministries of both nations. He also conveyed greetings to the Qatari emir and expressed appreciation for Qatar's consistent supply of liquefied natural gas, which helps meet Pakistan's domestic energy needs.

During discussions, the prime minister noted that nearly 300,000 Pakistani nationals currently work in Qatar, contributing to its development and prosperity. He highlighted potential areas for expanded economic cooperation, including trade, investment, agriculture, livestock, information technology, mining, and minerals. In response, the Qatari minister expressed gratitude for the hospitality shown by Pakistan and delivered congratulatory messages and best wishes from Emir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani, acknowledging Pakistan's role in promoting regional peace and stability.

This new security pact follows previous discussions held between Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi and his Qatari counterpart in Doha last month. During those earlier talks, both officials agreed to enhance bilateral cooperation concerning internal security matters. The current visit builds directly upon those prior engagements to solidify formal security frameworks between the two countries.

stories.title: L'Oreal and EssilorLuxottica in Talks to Buy Armani Stake
stories.summary:
French cosmetics company L’Oreal is currently engaged in discussions to acquire a 10 percent stake in the Italian fashion group Giorgio Armani. Eyewear manufacturer EssilorLuxottica is also participating in the talks and is positioned to take a 5 percent stake in the company. Meanwhile, luxury group LVMH has dropped out of the running to purchase a stake in the Italian brand. The negotiations are being handled with the assistance of the investment bank Rothschild, though a final agreement has not yet been reached.

The potential transactions stem from provisions in the will of the company's founder, Giorgio Armani, who passed away last year at the age of 91. His will stipulated that his heirs must dispose of approximately 15 percent of the company within a window falling between 12 and 18 months following his death. This mandatory deadline is set to arrive in early March of next year. The founder's will explicitly identified L’Oreal, EssilorLuxottica, and LVMH as preferred buyers for these initial stakes, without excluding other industry players of equal standing.

Subsequent phases of the Armani succession plan involve disposing of an additional 30 percent to 54.9 percent stake, or alternatively pursuing a stock market listing in the medium term. Sources close to the matter indicate that the Armani heirs ultimately favor an initial public offering over selling further stakes to large industry players. LVMH reportedly showed less appetite for participating in the ongoing acquisition process.

Representatives from Armani and EssilorLuxottica declined to comment on the ongoing negotiations. Similarly, L’Oreal and LVMH were not immediately available to provide statements regarding the reported talks. Both potential investing companies have maintained longstanding licensing partnerships with the fashion house for products such as fragrances and eyewear.

stories.title: Alibaba Surpasses Revenue Expectations Driven by Strong AI Cloud Growth
stories.summary:
Alibaba exceeded analyst expectations for its September-quarter revenue, propelled by a surge in demand for its artificial intelligence cloud services. China's largest e-commerce company reported that revenue from AI cloud and computing services grew by 53 percent to reach 60.97 billion yuan. This growth reflects the ongoing financial returns from the company's heavy investments in artificial intelligence infrastructure, proprietary models, and related products. Total quarterly revenue reached 271.52 billion yuan, topping the average analyst estimate of 269.81 billion yuan.

The company's reported profit more than tripled, bolstered by investment gains and improved operational performance. Excluding investment gains and other items, non-GAAP net income rose 92 percent to 19.9 billion yuan, supported by stronger profitability and narrowing losses in its quick-commerce operations. However, adjusted earnings per American Depositary Share came in at 8.10 yuan, falling short of analysts' expectations of 11.16 yuan. Alibaba's shares have declined by approximately 40 percent this year amid investor concerns regarding weak consumer demand within China.

Domestic and international e-commerce segments faced certain headwinds during the quarter. Revenue from China e-commerce declined by 5 percent due to slowing economic growth and a prolonged property crisis, while international e-commerce revenue dropped 8 percent following European Union customs reforms. E-commerce still accounts for nearly three-quarters of the company's total revenue. To support its future expansion, Alibaba increased its capital expenditure by 60 percent to 50.48 billion yuan, driving cash burn up to 34.47 billion yuan from 21.84 billion yuan a year earlier.

Alibaba is aggressively scaling its technological capabilities as part of its strategic focus. The company recently announced plans to expand its global data-centre capacity to more than 20 gigawatts by 2032, and noted that its next-generation Qwen 4 model is currently in training. Additionally, its chip-design unit, T-Head, unveiled a new AI processor scheduled for commercial release in early 2027, following a confidential Hong Kong listing filing earlier in the month.

stories.title: راولپنڈی ہولی فیملی اسپتال میں کیرو ابلیشن مشین کے ذریعے کینسر کا کامیاب علاج
stories.summary:
راولپنڈی کے ہولی فیملی اسپتال میں کیرو ابلیشن مشین کی مدد سے کینسر کی پہلی مریضہ کا علاج کامیابی کے ساتھ مکمل کر لیا گیا ہے۔ اس جدید طریقہ کار کے ذریعے پچاس سالہ خاتون کو جگر کے کینسر سے نجات دلائی گئی ہے۔ اسپتال انتظامیہ کے مطابق جگر کے کینسر کا یہ علاج ایک گھنٹے کے دورانیے پر مشتمل پروسیس کے ذریعے کیا گیا، اور اب مریضہ کو فالو اپ چیک اپ کے لیے دوبارہ اسپتال لایا جائے گا۔

انتظار گاہ یا اسپتال کے ریکارڈ کے مطابق اس مریضہ کے جگر میں موجود کینسر کے خاتمے کے لیے سولہ لاکھ روپے مالیت کا پروب استعمال کیا گیا۔ ہولی فیملی اسپتال میں اس جدید مشین کی تنصیب کے بعد اب مریضوں کے لیے جگر، گردے اور سینے کے کینسر کا علاج فعال کر دیا گیا ہے، اور اسپتال کے پاس پہلے مرحلے میں سولہ مریضوں کے علاج کے لیے اتنے ہی پروب دستیاب ہیں۔

اسپتال کے میڈیکل سپرنٹنڈنٹ نے واضح کیا ہے کہ جو بھی کینسر کے مریض اس مشین کے مخصوص کرائٹیریا پر پورا اتریں گے، ان کا علاج بالکل مفت کیا جائے گا۔ کیرو ابلیشن مشین کے ذریعے جگر، گردے اور سینے کے اندر دو سے تین سینٹی میٹر تک کے سائز کے کینسر ٹیومرز کا مؤثر طریقے سے خاتمہ کیا جا سکے گا۔

یہ طبی سہولت راولپنڈی کے اس بڑے سرکاری اسپتال میں کینسر کے مستحق مریضوں کے لیے ایک اہم پیشرفت ہے۔ اس سے نہ صرف مقامی سطح پر جدید ترین طبی سہولیات تک رسائی آسان ہوگی بلکہ کینسر کے موذی مرض میں مبتلا افراد کو مہنگے علاج سے بھی بڑی راحت ملے گی۔

stories.title: مخصوص نشستوں پر طارق فضل چوہدری کا بلاول بھٹو کو استعفیٰ دینے کا مشورہ
stories.summary:
وزیر پارلیمانی امور طارق فضل چوہدری نے اپنے ایک بیان میں کہا ہے کہ اگر چیئرمین پیپلز پارٹی بلاول بھٹو پنجاب کی بات کرتے ہیں تو انہیں سندھ کی صورتحال کا بھی جائزہ لینا چاہیے۔ انہوں نے دوٹوک الفاظ میں کہا کہ اگر مخصوص نشستیں دراصل پاکستان تحریک انصاف کی تھیں تو بلاول کو سب سے پہلے اپنی جماعت کی نشستوں سے استعفیٰ دینا چاہیے۔

طارق فضل چوہدری کا مزید کہنا تھا کہ جب تک بلاول بھٹو خود مخصوص نشستوں سے استعفیٰ نہیں دیتے، تب تک اس معاملے پر کوئی اور سوچ بچار نہیں کی جا سکتی۔ انہوں نے اس بات کا بھی ذکر کیا کہ ملک میں کسی بھی اہم معاملے پر عوام کی براہ راست رائے لینے کے لیے ریفرنڈم کا آئینی طریقہ کار پہلے سے موجود ہے۔

وفاقی وزیر نے اس موقع پر واضح کیا کہ بلاول بھٹو ان کی حکومت کے اتحادی ہیں اور مستقبل میں بھی اتحادی ہی رہیں گے۔ انہوں نے تسلیم کیا کہ پارلیمانی نظام میں اتحادی جماعتوں کو کسی بھی ایشو پر اپنا الگ مؤقف رکھنے کا پورا حق حاصل ہے۔

سیاسی حلقوں میں اس بیان کو اہم مانا جا رہا ہے کیونکہ اتحادی جماعتوں کے رہنماؤں کے درمیان مختلف آئینی و سیاسی امور پر بیانات کا تبادلہ جاری ہے۔ اس سے حکومت اور اس کے اتحادیوں کے باہمی تعلقات اور سیاسی حکمت عملی پر گہرے اثرات مرتب ہو رہے ہیں۔

stories.title: مسائل نئے صوبوں کے قیام سے حل ہوتے ہیں تو ضرور بننے چاہئیں، عبدالعلیم خان
stories.summary:
وفاقی وزیر مواصلات عبدالعلیم خان نے پشاور میں میڈیا سے گفتگو کرتے ہوئے کہا ہے کہ جن علاقوں میں نئے صوبوں کے قیام کی عوامی سطح پر مانگ موجود ہے، وہاں صوبے بننے چاہئیں۔ انہوں نے مزید کہا کہ اگر کراچی کے تمام مسائل پہلے ہی حل ہو چکے ہیں اور وہاں کے لوگ نئے صوبے کے خواہاں نہیں ہیں، تو پھر وہاں صوبہ بنانے کی ضرورت نہیں۔
